from math import cos, radians

# ---------------- dimensions ----------------
TOTAL_L = 80.1                    # overall length
BODY_D  = 48.6                    # cylinder diameter
BODY_R  = BODY_D / 2              # 24.3
HEX_LEN = 72.7                    # hexagon length
CYL_LEN = TOTAL_L - HEX_LEN       # 7.4  cylindrical end length
HEX_AF  = 42.3                    # across-flats
HEX_R   = HEX_AF / (2 * cos(radians(30)))   # ~24.42 circumradius

# ---------------- main body ----------------
# build with axis along local Z (0 -> TOTAL_L)
hex_sec = extrude(RegularPolygon(HEX_R, 6), amount=HEX_LEN)
cyl_sec = Pos(0, 0, HEX_LEN) * Cylinder(BODY_R, CYL_LEN,
                                        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = hex_sec + cyl_sec

# ---------------- axial holes (in the x=0 end face) ----------------
# central Ø6.7 through hole
part -= Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(6.7 / 2, TOTAL_L + 2.0,
                                   align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# 2x Ø3.8 x 41.4 deep
for y in (-5.2, 5.2):
    part -= Pos(y, 0, -0.5) * Cylinder(3.8 / 2, 41.9,
                                       align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# 2x Ø1.7 x 3.2 deep
for y in (-5.2, 5.2):
    part -= Pos(0, y, -0.5) * Cylinder(1.7 / 2, 3.7,
                                       align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- radial holes (drilled from the top, local -X) ----------------
def top_hole(zf, yf, dia, depth):
    """Hole starting above the part at local -X, drilled in +X."""
    start = -(HEX_R + 2.0)
    return (Pos(start, yf, zf) * Rot(0, 90, 0) *
            Cylinder(dia / 2, depth + 2.0,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))

# Ø6.1 THRU
part -= top_hole(11.0, 0.0, 6.1, 2 * BODY_R + 2)
# Ø3.2 x 48.6
part -= top_hole(32.6, 0.0, 3.2, 48.6)
# Ø4.0 x 27.5
part -= top_hole(47.5, 0.0, 4.0, 27.5)

# 4x Ø2.9 x 9.4  (rectangular pattern)
for xf in (32.6 - 5.45, 32.6 + 5.45):
    for yf in (-5.45, 5.45):

# 2x Ø2.5 x 4.8
for xf in (32.6 - 5.45, 32.6 + 5.45):
    part -= top_hole(xf, 0.0, 2.5, 4.8)

# ---------------- orient with the axis along X ----------------
part = Rot(0, 90, 0) * part

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W       = 80.0     # overall width (X)
H_VERT  = 62.1     # vertical plate height (Z)
D_HORIZ = 49.5     # horizontal plate depth (Y)
T       = 3.8      # plate thickness
RIB_W   = 7.6      # side rib width
RIB_RUN = 42.3     # side rib forward run from the back face
SLOT_W  = 3.8      # slotted hole width
SLOT_L  = 10.0     # slotted hole overall length
CHAM    = 1.9      # 4x C1.9 end chamfer (slot width/2 -> pointed ends)
SLOT_X1 = 21.3     # slot centres (symmetric)
SLOT_X2 = W - SLOT_X1
VSLOT_Z = 31.2     # vertical plate slot centre height
HSLOT_Y = 16.8     # horizontal plate slot centre

# ---------------- plates ----------------
vert  = Pos(W/2, T/2, H_VERT/2) * Box(W, T, H_VERT)
horiz = Pos(W/2, D_HORIZ/2, T/2) * Box(W, D_HORIZ, T)
part  = vert + horiz

# ---------------- side ribs (7.6 wide, 3.8 thick) ----------------
rib_len_h = RIB_RUN - T      # run along the base plate
for x0 in (0.0, W - RIB_W):
    rv = Pos(x0 + RIB_W/2, T + T/2, H_VERT/2) * Box(RIB_W, T, H_VERT)
    rh = Pos(x0 + RIB_W/2, T + rib_len_h/2, T + T/2) * Box(RIB_W, rib_len_h, T)
    part += rv + rh

# ---------------- keyhole slots (4x C1.9) ----------------
def slot_face():
    l = (SLOT_L - SLOT_W) / 2          # straight length each side
    h = SLOT_W / 2                     # half width = chamfer 1.9
    pts = [(-l, -h), (l, -h), (l + h, 0), (l, h), (-l, h), (-l - h, 0)]
    return make_face(Polyline(*pts, close=True))

# slots through the vertical plate, long axis along Z
vcut = extrude(Plane.XZ * Rot(0, 0, 90) * slot_face(), amount=20, both=True)
for cx in (SLOT_X1, SLOT_X2):

hcut = extrude(Plane.XY * Rot(0, 0, 90) * slot_face(), amount=20, both=True)
for cx in (SLOT_X1, SLOT_X2):
    part -= Pos(cx, HSLOT_Y, 0) * hcut

width   = 80.0    # overall width  (X)  - front view

height  = 42.3    # overall height (Z)  - side wall height
wall    = 7.6     # side wall thickness

# raised slot / boss features (4x C1.9, 2.8 wide, 1.5 HIGH)
boss_w  = 2.8     # slot width
boss_h1 = 36.1    # tall slot height
boss_h2 = 26.3    # short slot height
boss_t  = 1.5     # protrusion height  ("1.5 HIGH")
gap     = 25.9    # spacing between the two slots
cham    = 1.9     # 4x C1.9 corner chamfer

# ------------------- main body (U channel) -------------------
part = Box(width, depth, base_t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part += Box(wall, depth, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part += Pos(width - wall, 0, 0) * Box(wall, depth, height,
                                      align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ------------------- slot bosses on inner faces -------------------
def make_boss(h):
    b = Box(boss_t, boss_w, h, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    return chamfer(b.edges().filter_by(Axis.X), cham)

y1 = 10.0                 # centre of tall slot
y2 = y1 + gap             # centre of short slot

for x0 in (wall, width - wall - boss_t):
    for yc, h in ((y1, boss_h1), (y2, boss_h2)):
        part += Pos(x0, yc, height / 2) * make_boss(h)

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
OUTER_DIA = 23.9      # outer diameter
INNER_DIA = 17.4      # bore diameter
LENGTH    = 80.0      # overall length
SLOT_W    = 12.0      # width of the C opening
OVERALL_H = 22.4      # height of the C section
TIP_ANGLE = 30.0      # tip chamfer angle
TIP_RUN   = 15.1      # tip chamfer run

outer_r = OUTER_DIA / 2.0
inner_r = INNER_DIA / 2.0

# ---------------- blank: tube with bore ----------------
part = Cylinder(outer_r, LENGTH, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= Cylinder(inner_r, LENGTH + 2.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- C-section opening (slot from the top) ----------------
slot = Box(SLOT_W, OUTER_DIA + 2.0, LENGTH + 2.0,
           align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

R_OUT = OUTER_DIA / 2.0          # 11.95
R_IN  = INNER_DIA / 2.0          # 8.7
RISE  = TAPER_RUN * tan(radians(TAPER_ANGLE))   # 8.72 (radial fall of the taper)

part = Cylinder(R_OUT, LENGTH, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= Cylinder(R_IN, LENGTH, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= Pos(0, 0, LENGTH / 2) * Box(SLOT_WIDTH, 2 * R_OUT, LENGTH)

# ----- 30deg x 15.1 RUN taper on both tips of the "C" -----

    pts = [(s * (SLOT_WIDTH / 2 - RISE), 0.0),
           (s * (R_OUT + 5.0), 0.0),
           (s * (R_OUT + 5.0), TAPER_RUN),
           (s * SLOT_WIDTH / 2, TAPER_RUN)]
    if s < 0:
        pts.reverse()
    face = Plane.XZ * Polygon(*pts, align=None)
    part -= extrude(face, amount=R_OUT + 2.0, dir=(0, 1, 0))

from math import radians, cos, sin

# ---- Printed dimensions ----
OD = 23.9          # outer diameter
ID = 17.4          # inner bore diameter
LENGTH = 65.0      # overall length
GAP = 12.0         # width of the C opening (between tips)
HEIGHT = 22.4      # overall height of the section (reference)

R_OUT = OD / 2.0   # 11.95
R_IN = ID / 2.0    # 8.7

# Groove call-outs: "2x 30° x 15.1 RUN" (one groove either side of the gap)
GROOVE_SPAN = 30.0        # angular width of each groove
GROOVE_RUN = 15.1         # axial run of each groove
GROOVE_DEPTH = 1.5        # radial depth (recess into the wall)
GROOVE_CENTER = 45.0      # groove centred 45° off the opening axis


def arc_pts(r, a0, a1, n=12):
    """Points along a circular arc from a0 to a1 (degrees)."""
    return [
        (r * cos(radians(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n)),
         r * sin(radians(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n)))
        for i in range(n + 1)
    ]


with BuildPart() as part_b:
    # ---- C-shaped sleeve cross-section ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=R_OUT)
        Circle(radius=R_IN, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        # opening slot, 12 wide, from the centre line upward
        Rectangle(GAP, 2 * R_OUT,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                  mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=LENGTH)

    # ---- Two internal grooves (30° x 15.1 RUN) ----
    r2 = R_IN + GROOVE_DEPTH
    for s in (1, -1):
        a0 = s * (GROOVE_CENTER - GROOVE_SPAN / 2.0)
        a1 = s * (GROOVE_CENTER + GROOVE_SPAN / 2.0)
        pts = arc_pts(R_IN, a0, a1) + arc_pts(r2, a1, a0)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(LENGTH - GROOVE_RUN)):
            Polygon(*pts, align=None)
        extrude(amount=GROOVE_RUN, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = part_b.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

    (body_length,    -body_width / 2),
    (total_length,    0.0),                 # tapered tip point
    (body_length,     body_width / 2),
    (0.0,             body_width / 2),
]
body_profile = Polygon(*body_pts, align=None)
part = extrude(body_profile, body_height)

# ---- Three parallel tubes (legs) along -Y ----
# Base at the +Y edge of the body, extending 80 mm in -Y
for tx in tube_xs:
    tube = (
        Pos(tx, body_width / 2, 0)
        * Rot(90, 0, 0)                     # cylinder axis: Z -> -Y
        * Cylinder(
            tube_dia / 2,
            tube_length,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
        )
    )
    part = part + tube

# ---- Small cosmetic fillets at the tip (R0.8) ----
try:
    tip_edges = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.LINE).filter_by(
        lambda e: e.center().X > body_length + 1.0
    )
    # only fillet vertical tip edges
    vertical_tip_edges = [
        e for e in tip_edges
        if abs(e.tangent_at(0).Z) > 0.9
    ]
    if vertical_tip_edges:
        part = fillet(vertical_tip_edges, radius=0.8)
except Exception:
    pass

cbore_depth = 5.0           # counterbore depth

first_x     = 10.0          # first hole from left edge

small_depth = 5.0           # small hole depth

    # base plate

    # central ridge (10 wide, up to z = 7.5)

        Box(length, ridge_w, ridge_top - base_t,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

import math

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
L        = 80.0    # overall length  (X)
D        = 26.7    # overall depth   (Y)
H        = 33.3    # max height at right end
H_LEFT   = 16.7    # height at the left end
X_STEP   = 53.3    # end of curved top / start of flat top
TAB      = 21.7    # right pocket length (53.3 + 21.7 = 75.0)
RAB_L    = 8.0     # bottom-right relief length
RAB_H    = 5.0     # bottom-right relief height

# ---- arc through (0,H_LEFT) and (X_STEP,H), horizontal tangent at right ----
dx, dz = X_STEP, H - H_LEFT
R  = (dx*dx + dz*dz) / (2.0*dz)
cx, cz = X_STEP, H - R
a0 = math.atan2(H_LEFT - cz, 0.0 - cx)
a1 = math.pi / 2.0
am = 0.5 * (a0 + a1)
mx = cx + R*math.cos(am)
mz = cz + R*math.sin(am)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # base block
    Box(L, D, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # curved top: remove the wedge above the arc (left portion)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((0.0, H_LEFT), (0.0, H + 10.0), (X_STEP, H + 10.0), (X_STEP, H))
            ThreePointArc((X_STEP, H), (mx, mz), (0.0, H_LEFT))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=-D, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # bottom-right relief (rabbet)
    with Locations((L - RAB_L/2.0, D/2.0, RAB_H/2.0)):

def sector(radius, height):
    """Quarter (90°) sector disc, first quadrant, extruded from z=0."""
    prof = Circle(radius) & Rectangle(radius, radius, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    return extrude(prof, amount=height)

part += Pos(0, 0, H_BASE) * sector(R_TOP, H_BODY - H_BASE)

    part -= Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(
        HOLE_R, H_TOTAL, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

cross_solid = h_cyl + v_cyl

    e for e in cross_solid.edges()

]
if intersection_edges:
    cross_solid = fillet(intersection_edges, radius=R_large)

    radius=cap_OD / 2, height=cap_len, rotation=(0, 90, 0)

)

    radius=cap_OD / 2, height=cap_len
)

    radius=cap_OD / 2, height=cap_len
)

part = cross_solid + caps

]

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----
ARM_LEN   = 40.0     # centre to arm end  -> overall 80.0
TUBE_OD   = 20.0     # arm outer diameter
CAP_OD    = 24.0     # end collar outer diameter (from 51.6 = 40 + 12 - 0.4)
CAP_LEN   = 12.4     # collar length (from end face)
BORE_D    = 16.4     # through bore diameter
R_SMALL   = 0.4      # 8x R0.4 shoulder fillets
R_LARGE   = 0.9      # 8x R0.9 rim fillets

TUBE_LEN  = ARM_LEN - CAP_LEN   # 27.6 exposed tube length


def make_arm():
    """One tubular arm with its end collar, built along +Z from the centre."""
    with BuildPart() as bp:
        Cylinder(TUBE_OD / 2, TUBE_LEN,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        with Locations((0, 0, TUBE_LEN)):
            Cylinder(CAP_OD / 2, CAP_LEN,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

        # concave fillet where the collar meets the tube
        shoulder = bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(e.radius - TUBE_OD / 2) < 1e-6
            and abs(e.center().Z - TUBE_LEN) < 1e-6)
        fillet(shoulder, R_SMALL)

        # convex fillet on the outer edge of the collar back face
        shoulder_out = bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(e.radius - CAP_OD / 2) < 1e-6
            and abs(e.center().Z - TUBE_LEN) < 1e-6)
        fillet(shoulder_out, R_SMALL)

        # rounded rim at the free end of the collar
        rim = bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(e.radius - CAP_OD / 2) < 1e-6
            and abs(e.center().Z - ARM_LEN) < 1e-6)
        fillet(rim, R_LARGE)

    return bp.part


# four coplanar arms (+Z, -Z, +X, -X) forming the cross
arm = make_arm()
part = (arm
        + Rot(180, 0, 0) * arm
        + Rot(0, 90, 0) * arm
        + Rot(0, -90, 0) * arm)

# through bore along both axes
part -= Cylinder(BORE_D / 2, 200)
part -= Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(BORE_D / 2, 200)

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
total_h  = 55.6          # overall height
bore_d   = 26.9          # central through bore

ring_od  = 45.1          # top ring outer diameter
ring_h   = 4.0

neck_od  = 32.2          # narrow neck below the ring
neck_h   = 3.0

thr_od   = 38.4          # stepped / threaded body
thr_h    = 8.0

hex_af   = 45.6          # hex across flats
hex_h    = 13.2

tube_od  = 38.4          # bottom tube
tube_h   = total_h - (ring_h + neck_h + thr_h + hex_h)

def disc(d, h, z):
    return Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(d / 2, h,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- build outer profile ----------------
z = 0.0
tube    = disc(tube_od, tube_h, z);                       z += tube_h
hexbody = Pos(0, 0, z) * extrude(
              RegularPolygon(hex_af / 2, 6, major_radius=False), hex_h)
z += hex_h
thr     = disc(thr_od,  thr_h,  z);                       z += thr_h
neck    = disc(neck_od, neck_h, z);                       z += neck_h
ring    = disc(ring_od, ring_h, z)

part = tube + hexbody + thr + neck + ring

# ---------------- central bore ----------------
part -= Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(bore_d / 2, total_h + 2,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- top chamfer C0.3 ----------------
top_edges = part.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - total_h) < 1e-6)
part = chamfer(top_edges, 0.3)

# ---------------- side notches on the hex body ----------------
for ang in (0.0, 180.0):
    notch = (Rot(0, 0, ang)
             * Pos(hex_af / 2 - 1.5, 0, tube_h + hex_h / 2)
             * Box(6.0, 12.0, 8.0))
    part -= notch

from build123d import *

# ---------- Dimensions (mm) ----------
hex_af      = 45.6      # hex across flats
hex_h       = 14.0
top_d       = 32.2      # top cylindrical section OD
top_h       = 6.0
thread_d    = 45.1      # threaded section OD
thread_h    = 12.0
groove_d    = 38.4      # grooved section OD
groove_h    = 3.0
short_d     = 32.2      # narrowed groove OD
short_h     = 2.5
body_d      = 47.0      # bottom body OD
body_h      = 25.0

# Internal
bore_d      = 26.9      # internal bore
bore_depth  = 55.6      # distance from top face

hex_r = (hex_af / 2.0) / math.cos(math.radians(30))

# ---------- Build stacked outer profile bottom-up ----------
z = 0.0
segments = []

segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(body_d/2, body_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += body_h

segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(groove_d/2, groove_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += groove_h

segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(short_d/2, short_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += short_h

segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(groove_d/2, groove_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += groove_h

segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(thread_d/2, thread_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += thread_h

# Hex flange
segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * extrude(RegularPolygon(hex_r, 6), hex_h))
z += hex_h

# Top cylindrical knob
segments.append(Pos(0, 0, z) * Cylinder(top_d/2, top_h,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
z += top_h

total_h = z

# Union all
part = segments[0]
for s in segments[1:]:
    part = part + s

# ---------- Internal bore from the top ----------
bore = Pos(0, 0, total_h) * Cylinder(bore_d/2, bore_depth,
                                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX))
part = part - bore

# Small counterbore at the very top for the chamfered opening
top_cb_d   = top_d - 2 * 1.3       # approximate opening
top_cb_len = 2.0
counterbore = Pos(0, 0, total_h) * Cylinder(top_cb_d/2, top_cb_len,
                                            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX))
# keep the counterbore only if larger than bore
if top_cb_d > bore_d:
    part = part - counterbore

# ---------- Edge finishes ----------
edges_to_chamfer = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - total_h) < 1e-6
)
if edges_to_chamfer:
    try:
        part = chamfer(edges_to_chamfer, length=0.3)
    except Exception:
        pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

with BuildPart() as bp:

from build123d import *

# Dimensions from drawing
L = 80.0                # overall length
t = 3.3                 # end plate thickness
H = 49.8                # overall height of end plate profile
W_top = 49.8            # max width (top) of end plate
W_bot = 41.5            # bottom width of end plate
hole_d = 8.3            # hole diameter
hole_r = hole_d / 2
hole_y = 16.6           # hole center distance from centerline (Y)
hole_z = H / 2          # hole center height
wall = 3.3              # wall thickness of central channel

# Derived
chamfer = (W_top - W_bot) / 2   # 4.15
h1 = H - chamfer                # height of straight vertical section

# ---------- End plate profile ----------
def end_plate_profile():
    pts = [
        (-W_bot/2, 0),
        (W_bot/2, 0),
        (W_bot/2, h1),
        (W_top/2, H),
        (-W_top/2, H),
        (-W_bot/2, h1),
    ]
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as ln:
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    return sk.sketch

# Create first end plate (X = 0 .. t)
plate_sk = end_plate_profile()
plate1 = extrude(plate_sk, amount=t)

# Second end plate (X = L-t .. L)
plate2 = plate1.translate((L - t, 0, 0))

# ---------- Central U-channel body ----------
central_length = L - 2*t
central_width = 16.6
central_body = Box(central_length, central_width, H)
central_body = central_body.translate((L/2, 0, H/2))

# Pocket to create open-top channel
pocket_len = central_length
pocket_width = central_width - 2*wall      # 10.0
pocket_height = H - wall                  # 46.5
pocket = Box(pocket_len, pocket_width, pocket_height)
pocket = pocket.translate((L/2, 0, wall + pocket_height/2))

# Combine all positive volumes
part = plate1 + plate2 + central_body - pocket

# ---------- Holes ----------
# 4 holes in the two end plates (2 per plate), along X axis
for x_center in [t/2, L - t/2]:
    for y_sign in [1, -1]:
        hole = Cylinder(hole_r, t + 2, rotation=(0, 90, 0))
        hole = hole.translate((x_center, y_sign * hole_y, hole_z))
        part -= hole

# Additional 2 holes through the central body along Y axis (total 6 holes)
for x_pos in [L/2 - 15, L/2 + 15]:
    hole = Cylinder(hole_r, central_width + 2, rotation=(90, 0, 0))
    hole = hole.translate((x_pos, 0, hole_z))
    part -= hole

# ---------- Export ----------
export_step(part, "output.step")

key_len    = 1.7

plate = Box(plate_len, W, t, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=r_corner)

# ---------------- bent flange at right end (going down) ----------------
flange = Pos(plate_len + t / 2, 0, t - flange_h / 2) * Box(t, W, flange_h)
part = part + flange

# fillet the free vertical edges of the flange
x_out = plate_len + t
fl_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(e.center().X - x_out) < 1e-3
]
if fl_edges:
    try:
        part = fillet(fl_edges, radius=r_corner)
    except Exception:
        pass

# ---------------- slot in the flat plate ----------------
slot_face = Pos(slot_start + slot_cc / 2 + slot_w / 2, 0, 0) * SlotCenterToCenter(
    slot_cc, slot_w
)
part = part - extrude(slot_face, amount=t * 2, both=True)

# ---------------- holes in the flange ----------------
flange_bot_z = t - flange_h
hole_z = flange_bot_z + key_len + hole_d / 2
hole_y = hole_loc_y - W / 2

# ø9.5 through hole (axis along X, through flange thickness)
hole_cut = Pos(plate_len + t / 2, hole_y, hole_z) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
    hole_d / 2, t * 3
)
part = part - hole_cut

# 1.5 wide keyhole slot from flange bottom edge up to the hole
key_cut = Pos(
    plate_len + t / 2,
    hole_y,
    (flange_bot_z + hole_z) / 2,
) * Box(t * 3, key_w, hole_z - flange_bot_z + 0.5)
part = part - key_cut

# ---------------- output ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

def make_flange(x0: float):
    """One side flange, extruded in +X from plane YZ located at x0."""

        with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(x0)):
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline(*flange_pts, close=True)
            make_face()
        extrude(amount=t)

        fillet(pick(30.0, 52.0),  5.3)
        fillet(pick(23.2, 41.0),  6.7)   # 2 x R6.7 hook

r_in      = 1.2            # 4x R1.2  inner bend radius
hole_dia  = 7.5            # Ø7.5 hole
hole_z    = 45.4           # hole centre height from bottom
slot_r    = 6.7            # slot end radius
slot_h    = 13.3           # slot total height

# ---------------- U-channel: back plate + two side flanges ----------------
back = Box(w, t, h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

flange_l = Pos(-w/2, 0, 0) * Box(t, flange_d, h,
                                 align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
flange_r = Pos(w/2 - t, 0, 0) * Box(t, flange_d, h,
                                    align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

channel = back + flange_l + flange_r

# 2x R3.5 outer bend fillets
outer_edges = channel.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(abs(e.center().X) - w/2) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Y) < 1e-6)
channel = fillet(outer_edges, r_out)

# 2x R1.2 inner bend fillets
inner_edges = channel.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(abs(e.center().X) - (w/2 - t)) < 1e-6
              and abs(e.center().Y - t) < 1e-6)
channel = fillet(inner_edges, r_in)

# ---------------- bottom foot -------------------------------------------
foot = Pos(0, t, 0) * Box(w, depth - t, t,
                          align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = channel + foot

# ---------------- Ø7.5 mounting hole in the back plate -------------------
part -= Pos(0, t/2, hole_z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_dia/2, t + 6)

# ---------------- bottom slot in the back plate --------------------------
profile = (Rectangle(2*slot_r, slot_h - slot_r,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
           + Pos(0, slot_h - slot_r) * Circle(slot_r))
slot_face = Plane.XZ.offset(-1) * profile
part -= extrude(slot_face, amount=t + 1.5, both=True)

    # ---- circular top plate ----
    with Locations((0, 0, total_h - plate_t / 2)):
        Cylinder(plate_r, plate_t)

    # ---- three legs ----

        x = leg_pos_r * cos(radians(a))

            Cylinder(notch_r, plate_t + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
from math import radians, cos, sin

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
plate_dia = 80.0          # top plate / skirt outer diameter
plate_thk = 5.0           # top plate thickness
total_h   = 40.0          # overall height
skirt_id  = 74.0          # inner diameter of the skirt
leg_h     = total_h - plate_thk          # 35

leg_centers   = [30.0, 150.0, 270.0]     # leg centres (deg)
leg_width_deg = 20.0                     # angular width of each leg
slot_half_deg = (120.0 - leg_width_deg) / 2.0   # 50 -> slots at 90/210/330

bc_dia   = 35.2           # bolt circle
hole_dia = 6.7
n_holes  = 9

notch_dia = 6.7           # rim scallops, thru
notch_x   = 37.0          # centres at +/-37 in X

# ---------------- 1. plate + skirt (cup) ----------------
part = Cylinder(plate_dia / 2, total_h,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= Pos(0, 0, -1) * Cylinder(skirt_id / 2, leg_h + 1,
                                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- 2. slot cuts (3 legs) ----------------
R = 60.0
for c in (90.0, 210.0, 330.0):
    a0 = radians(c - slot_half_deg)
    a1 = radians(c + slot_half_deg)
    wire = Wire.make_polygon(
        [Vector(0, 0, 0),
         Vector(R * cos(a0), R * sin(a0), 0),
         Vector(R * cos(a1), R * sin(a1), 0)],
        close=True)
    slot = extrude(Face(wire), amount=leg_h + 1)
    part -= Pos(0, 0, -1) * slot

# ---------------- 3. fillets ----------------
# R0.7 on the vertical slot/leg edges
try:
    vedges = [e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
              if 0.1 < e.center().Z < leg_h - 0.1]
    part = fillet(vedges, radius=0.7)
except Exception:
    pass

# R1.3 on the bottom edges of the legs
try:
    bedges = [e for e in part.edges()
              if abs(e.center().Z) < 0.05 and e.length > 8.0]
    part = fillet(bedges, radius=1.3)
except Exception:
    pass

# ---------------- 4. bolt-circle holes ----------------
for i in range(n_holes):
    a = radians(i * 360.0 / n_holes)
    part -= Pos(bc_dia / 2 * cos(a), bc_dia / 2 * sin(a), plate_thk + leg_h - 1) * \
            Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, plate_thk + 2,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- 5. rim scallop notches (thru) ----------------
for sx in (1.0, -1.0):
    part -= Pos(sx * notch_x, 0, -1) * Cylinder(notch_dia / 2, total_h + 2,
                                                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

part = part.clean()

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

plate_dia = 80.0
plate_r = plate_dia / 2
plate_thk = 5.0
total_h = 40.0
body_h = total_h - plate_thk          # 35

skirt_od = 74.0
skirt_r = skirt_od / 2
skirt_wall = 8.0
skirt_ir = skirt_r - skirt_wall       # 29

hole_d = 6.7
hole_r = hole_d / 2
hole_bc_r = 35.2 / 2
n_holes = 9

leg_ang = 30.0
slot_ang = 120.0 - leg_ang

extra_hole_r = 31.0
extra_hole_ang = -45.0

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # Top flange Ø80 x 5
    with Locations((0, 0, total_h - plate_thk / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=plate_r, height=plate_thk)

    # Skirt ring (outer Ø74, hollow)
    with Locations((0, 0, body_h / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=skirt_r, height=body_h)
    with Locations((0, 0, body_h / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=skirt_ir, height=body_h, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Cut 3 wedge slots -> leaves 3 legs (at 0°, 120°, 240°)
    for i in range(3):
        slot_center = 60.0 + i * 120.0
        a0 = slot_center - slot_ang / 2
        a1 = slot_center + slot_ang / 2
        n = 24
        pts = [(0.0, 0.0)]
        for k in range(n + 1):
            a = a0 + (a1 - a0) * k / n
            rr = skirt_r + 2.0
            pts.append((rr * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
                        rr * math.sin(math.radians(a))))
        pts.append((0.0, 0.0))
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline(*pts)
            make_face()
        extrude(amount=body_h, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 9x Ø6.7 THRU on Ø35.2 BC
    for i in range(n_holes):
        a = i * (360.0 / n_holes)
        x = hole_bc_r * math.cos(math.radians(a))
        y = hole_bc_r * math.sin(math.radians(a))
        with Locations((x, y, total_h - plate_thk / 2)):
            Cylinder(radius=hole_r, height=plate_thk + 10, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Extra Ø6.7 THRU hole near perimeter
    ex = extra_hole_r * math.cos(math.radians(extra_hole_ang))
    ey = extra_hole_r * math.sin(math.radians(extra_hole_ang))
    with Locations((ex, ey, total_h - plate_thk / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_r, height=plate_thk + 10, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_t  = 5.0
total_h  = 40.0
leg_h    = total_h - plate_t          # 35.0

leg_span  = 30.0                      # degrees
n_legs    = 3

hole_r  = 6.7 / 2
bc_r    = 35.2 / 2
n_holes = 9

R_LEG   = 0.7
R_JOINT = 1.3

# ---------------- single leg sector (annular wedge) ----------------
half = radians(leg_span / 2)

with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as leg_sk:
    with BuildLine():
        CenterArc((0, 0), leg_r_out, -leg_span / 2, leg_span)
        Line((leg_r_out * cos(half),  leg_r_out * sin(half)),
             (leg_r_in  * cos(half),  leg_r_in  * sin(half)))
        CenterArc((0, 0), leg_r_in, leg_span / 2, -leg_span)
        Line((leg_r_in  * cos(-half), leg_r_in  * sin(-half)),
             (leg_r_out * cos(-half), leg_r_out * sin(-half)))
    make_face()

leg_face = leg_sk.sketch

# ---------------- top plate ----------------
part = Pos(0, 0, leg_h) * Cylinder(plate_r, plate_t,
                                   align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- legs ----------------
for i in range(n_legs):
    part += Rot(0, 0, i * 360.0 / n_legs) * extrude(leg_face, amount=leg_h)

    a = radians(i * 360.0 / n_holes)

            Cylinder(hole_r, plate_t, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    c = e.center()
    return (c.X ** 2 + c.Y ** 2) ** 0.5

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------- dimensions from the drawing ----------------
DISC_DIA   = 80.0                 # Ø80 top plate
DISC_THK   = 5.0                  # plate thickness
TOTAL_H    = 40.0                 # overall height
LEG_H      = TOTAL_H - DISC_THK   # 35 tall legs

LEG_OUT_R  = 40.0                 # leg outer face flush with plate rim
LEG_IN_R   = 20.0                 # leg inner radius
LEG_WIDTH  = 20.0                 # tangential width of each leg

R_BOTTOM   = 1.3                  # 3× R1.3  (leg bottoms)
R_EDGE     = 0.7                  # 15× R0.7 (leg vertical edges)

HOLE_DIA   = 6.7                  # 9× Ø6.7 THRU
BC_DIA     = 35.2                 # on Ø35.2 B.C.
N_HOLES    = 9

NOTCH_R    = 1.3                  # rim notches
LEG_ANGLES = (90.0, 210.0, 330.0)

# ---------------- build each leg individually ----------------
legs = []
r_mid = (LEG_OUT_R + LEG_IN_R) / 2.0
for ang in LEG_ANGLES:
    # box length = radial thickness, width = tangential, height = leg height
    leg = Box(LEG_OUT_R - LEG_IN_R, LEG_WIDTH, LEG_H,
              align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # shift radially so it spans r = 20 .. 40, then rotate to leg angle
    leg = Pos(r_mid, 0, 0) * leg
    leg = Rot(0, 0, ang) * leg

    # fillet the 4 vertical edges -> R0.7
    v_edges = leg.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    leg = fillet(v_edges, R_EDGE)

    # fillet the bottom edges -> R1.3
    b_edges = [e for f in leg.faces() if abs(f.center().Z) < 1e-6
               for e in f.edges()]
    leg = fillet(b_edges, R_BOTTOM)
    legs.append(leg)

# ---------------- top plate ----------------
plate = Pos(0, 0, TOTAL_H - DISC_THK / 2) * Cylinder(DISC_DIA / 2, DISC_THK)

# ---------------- rim notches (3× R1.3) ----------------
for ang in LEG_ANGLES:
    a = math.radians(ang)
    x = LEG_OUT_R * math.cos(a)
    y = LEG_OUT_R * math.sin(a)
    notch = Pos(x, y, TOTAL_H - DISC_THK) * Cylinder(
        NOTCH_R, DISC_THK * 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    plate = plate - notch

# ---------------- 9 x Ø6.7 THRU on Ø35.2 B.C. ----------------
for i in range(N_HOLES):
    a = math.radians(90.0 + i * 360.0 / N_HOLES)
    x = BC_DIA / 2 * math.cos(a)
    y = BC_DIA / 2 * math.sin(a)
    hole = Pos(x, y, TOTAL_H - DISC_THK) * Cylinder(
        HOLE_DIA / 2, DISC_THK * 3, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    plate = plate - hole

# ---------------- assemble ----------------
part = plate
for leg in legs:
    part = part + leg

export_step(part, "output.step")

right_t      = 5     # thickness of the short plate
total_x      = 80    # overall length
bottom_t     = 5     # bottom connecting flange thickness
fillet_r     = 10    # 2x R10 fillets

hole_d       = 20    # Ø20 through hole
hole_cx      = 23    # Ø20 hole center (13 from left edge + R10)
hole_cz      = 22    # Ø20 hole center height

small_d      = 6     # 4x Ø6 through holes
small_z      = [5, 27]   # 5 from bottom, 22 apart

# ---- Build ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Front-view profile, extruded in the Y direction
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0, 0),
                (0, left_h),
                (left_t, left_h),
                (left_t, bottom_t),
                (total_x - right_t, bottom_t),
                (total_x - right_t, right_h),
                (total_x, right_h),
                (total_x, 0),
                (0, 0),
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=-plate_w)   # goes to Y = [0 .. 64]

    # R10 fillets on the two inner vertical-rib edges
    rib_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - bottom_t) < 1e-3
        and (abs(e.center().X - left_t) < 1e-3
             or abs(e.center().X - (total_x - right_t)) < 1e-3)
    )
    fillet(rib_edges, radius=fillet_r)

    # Ø20 through hole (axis along Y)
    with Locations((hole_cx, plate_w / 2, hole_cz)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_d / 2,
                 height=plate_w + 10,
                 rotation=(90, 0, 0),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 4x Ø6 through holes in the short right plate (axis along X)

                Cylinder(radius=small_d / 2,
                         height=20,
                         rotation=(0, 90, 0),
                         mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W      = 48.0     # overall width              (X)
H      = 80.0     # overall height             (Z)
T      = 12.0     # maximum thickness          (Y)  (top view)
T_STEP = 8.0      # thickness of the stepped end bands
Z_LOW  = 53.7     # bottom face -> lower step
Z_HIGH = 64.0     # bottom face -> upper step
R_FIL  = 3.2      # 17x R3.2 edge fillets

# ---------------- derived ----------------
z_bot   = -H / 2.0                 # -40
z_lo    = z_bot + Z_LOW            #  13.7
z_hi    = z_bot + Z_HIGH           #  24.0
y_front = -T / 2.0                 #  -6  (front face)
depth   = T - T_STEP               #   4  recess depth

# ---------------- base block ----------------
part = Box(W, T, H)

# ---------------- recess front face of the top & bottom bands ----------------
yc = y_front - 1.0 + (depth + 1.0) / 2.0          # -4.5

# bottom band  (0 -> 53.7)
part -= Pos(0, yc, (z_bot - 1.0 + z_lo) / 2.0) * Box(
    W + 10.0, depth + 1.0, (z_lo - z_bot) + 1.0
)
# top band  (64.0 -> 80)
part -= Pos(0, yc, (z_hi + H / 2.0 + 1.0) / 2.0) * Box(
    W + 10.0, depth + 1.0, (H / 2.0 - z_hi) + 1.0
)

# ---------------- R3.2 fillets on the outer edges ----------------
edges = list(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z))                  # 8 vertical corner edges
edges += list(part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1].edges())       # 4 top face edges
edges += list(part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0].edges())        # 4 bottom face edges
part = fillet(edges, R_FIL)

export_step(part, "output.step")

hex_face = Polygon(*hex_pts, align=None)

v_dn = (hex_R*math.cos(math.radians(-30)), hex_R*math.sin(math.radians(-30)))
c_up = (cd + right_R*math.cos(math.radians(22)),  right_R*math.sin(math.radians(22)))

part = part + extrude(right_face, amount=web_thick/2, both=True)

rib_angle   = 21.8        # rib flank angle (deg)
n_ribs      = 12          # number of ribs

r_body = ribbed_d / 2.0
r_tip  = rib_tip_d / 2.0
hw_tip = rib_w / 2.0
r_in   = r_body - 2.0     # extend rib inward to guarantee overlap
hw_in  = hw_tip + (r_tip - r_in) * math.tan(math.radians(rib_angle))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ribbed skirt (Ø68.8 core + 12 tapered ribs up to Ø79.4)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
skirt = Cylinder(r_body, ribbed_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

rib_profile = Polygon(
    (r_tip, -hw_tip),
    (r_tip,  hw_tip),
    (r_in,   hw_in),
    (r_in,  -hw_in),
    align=None,
)
rib_solid = extrude(rib_profile, ribbed_h)

for i in range(n_ribs):
    skirt += rib_solid.rotate(Axis.Z, i * 360.0 / n_ribs)

# C0.6 chamfer on the 12 rib edges at the bottom face

    bottom_edges = skirt.edges().filter_by_position(Axis.Z, -1e-6, 1e-6)
    skirt = chamfer(bottom_edges, cham)
except Exception:
    pass

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
body = Cylinder(body_d / 2.0, cyl_h,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
body = body.translate((0, 0, ribbed_h))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hex head, 64 A/F
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hex_r = (hex_af / 2.0) / math.cos(math.radians(30.0))
hex_head = extrude(RegularPolygon(radius=hex_r, side_count=6, rotation=30), hex_h)
hex_head = hex_head.translate((0, 0, ribbed_h + cyl_h))

part = skirt + body + hex_head

hole = Cylinder(hole_d / 2.0, overall_h + 4.0,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
part -= hole.translate((0, 0, overall_h / 2.0))

export_step(part, "output.step")

root_r  = knurl_root / 2.0

    crest_r, knurl_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
)

    collar.edges().filter_by_position(Axis.Z, -knurl_h - 0.01, -knurl_h + 0.01),
    length=cham,
)

    hole_d / 2.0, total_h + 2.0, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)
)

# Convert interior angles to successive normal-direction increments of the
# tangent faces.  ("interior angle = 180 - normal increment")
deltas = [180.0 - a for a in angles]

# Close the polygon (top & bottom kept horizontal), split into two halves
err1 = 180.0 - sum(deltas[:4])
err2 = 180.0 - sum(deltas[4:])
deltas = [d + err1 / 4 for d in deltas[:4]] + [d + err2 / 4 for d in deltas[4:]]

# Absolute face-normal angles, first face = top face (normal = +Y = 90 deg)
normal_angles = [90.0]
for d in deltas[:-1]:
    normal_angles.append(normal_angles[-1] + d)

# The octagon is tangential to a circle of radius "across_flats/2";
# every face is the line  n.p = r .
def vertex(r, a1, a2):
    n1 = (cos(radians(a1)), sin(radians(a1)))
    n2 = (cos(radians(a2)), sin(radians(a2)))
    det = n1[0] * n2[1] - n1[1] * n2[0]
    return ((r * n2[1] - r * n1[1]) / det,
            (n1[0] * r - n2[0] * r) / det)

inner_pts = [vertex(across_flats / 2.0 - wall_t, normal_angles[i - 1], normal_angles[i]) for i in range(N)]

TOTAL_LEN   = 80.0      # overall length
FLANGE_D    = 37.2      # flange outside diameter
FLANGE_AF   = 33.7      # wrench flats across-flats on flange
FLANGE_T    = 6.0       # flange thickness
CH_FLANGE   = 1.5       # 2x C1.5 flange chamfers

BODY_D      = 23.8      # main body diameter (23.8 A/F)
SMALL_D     = 10.5      # nose diameter
PIN_D       = 5.2       # center pin diameter
CH_TIP      = 0.7       # C0.7 pin tip chamfer
CH_BASE     = 0.1       # C0.1 pin base chamfer

# axial stations (Z = 0 at flange face, +Z toward pin tip)
Z_BODY_END   = 46.0
Z_CONE_END   = 53.0
Z_SMALL_END  = 56.0
Z_PIN_START  = 58.0
Z_TIP        = TOTAL_LEN

# internal bores
D_CB1        = 18.1     # counterbore dia
L_CB1        = 10.8     # counterbore depth
D_RELIEF     = 17.5     # relief dia
L_RELIEF     = 0.2      # relief depth
D_MAIN       = 21.7     # main thru bore dia
D_PIN_HOLE   = 3.4      # pin passage dia
Z_HOLE_END   = 52.0     # where the 3.4 bore starts

rf = FLANGE_D / 2.0
rb = BODY_D   / 2.0
rs = SMALL_D  / 2.0
rp = PIN_D    / 2.0

# ---------------- outer body of revolution ----------------
pts = [
    (0.0,               0.0),
    (rf - CH_FLANGE,    0.0),                 # flange face chamfer
    (rf,                CH_FLANGE),
    (rf,                FLANGE_T - CH_FLANGE),
    (rf - CH_FLANGE,    FLANGE_T),            # flange back chamfer
    (rb,                FLANGE_T),
    (rb,                Z_BODY_END),
    (rs,                Z_CONE_END),          # taper
    (rs,                Z_SMALL_END),
    (rp,                Z_PIN_START),         # taper to pin
    (rp,                Z_TIP - CH_TIP),
    (rp - CH_TIP,       Z_TIP),               # C0.7 tip chamfer
    (0.0,               Z_TIP),
    (0.0,               0.0),
]

profile = make_face(Polyline(*[(x, 0.0, z) for x, z in pts]))
part = revolve(profile, Axis.Z, 360)

# ---------------- internal bores ----------------
def pocket(r, z0, z1):
    return Pos(0, 0, z0) * Cylinder(r, z1 - z0,
                                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

bores  = pocket(D_CB1 / 2.0, 0.0, L_CB1)
bores += pocket(D_RELIEF / 2.0, L_CB1, L_CB1 + L_RELIEF)
bores += pocket(D_MAIN / 2.0, L_CB1 + L_RELIEF, Z_BODY_END)
bores += Pos(0, 0, Z_BODY_END) * Cone(D_MAIN / 2.0, D_PIN_HOLE / 2.0,
                                      Z_HOLE_END - Z_BODY_END,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
bores += pocket(D_PIN_HOLE / 2.0, Z_HOLE_END, Z_TIP)

part -= bores

# ---------------- wrench flats on the flange ----------------
part -= Pos( FLANGE_AF / 2.0, 0, FLANGE_T / 2.0) * Box(10.0, 60.0, FLANGE_T + 4.0)
part -= Pos(-FLANGE_AF / 2.0, 0, FLANGE_T / 2.0) * Box(10.0, 60.0, FLANGE_T + 4.0)

# ---------------- small base chamfer on pin ----------------
base_edges = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.arc_center.Z - Z_PIN_START) < 1e-6 and abs(e.radius - rp) < 1e-6)
if base_edges:
    part = chamfer(base_edges, CH_BASE)

export_step(part, "output.step")

cube_w = 48.6          # cube width (front view)
cube_d = 48.9          # cube depth  (right view)
wall = 5.0             # frame wall thickness
opening = 38.6         # square opening size
opening_r = 6.1        # opening corner radius (8x R6.1)
post_len = 33.8        # post protrusion length
post_a = 7.6           # top post across-flats (7.6 A/F)
post_b = 9.0           # bottom post across-flats (9.0 A/F)
post_r = 3.1           # post corner fillet (3x R3.1)
off_vert = 30.1 / 2    # vertical offset of posts
off_depth = 30.9 / 2   # depth offset of posts

# ---- Base cube ----
part = Box(cube_w, cube_d, cube_w)

# ---- Cut square openings through all three axes ----
for pl in (Plane.XY, Plane.YZ, Plane.XZ):
    sk = pl * RectangleRounded(opening, opening, opening_r)
    part -= extrude(sk, amount=100, both=True)

# ---- Helper to add a post ----
def add_post(side, y_off, z_off):
    pl = Plane.YZ.offset(-cube_w / 2 - post_len)
    sk = pl * Pos(0, y_off, z_off) * RectangleRounded(side, side, post_r)
    return extrude(sk, amount=post_len)

# Post A (upper / front)
part += add_post(post_a, -off_depth, off_vert)
# Post B (lower / back)
part += add_post(post_b, off_depth, -off_vert)

part = part.clean()

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ---- Dimensions from drawing ----
outer_width = 80.0      # overall width of the U channel
height = 56.4           # overall height of the U channel
length = 56.4           # length of the channel (extrusion)
wall_thk = 4.1          # side wall thickness
base_thk = 4.1          # base thickness
chamfer_h = 8.3         # height of chamfer feature on inner top edge
chamfer_angle = 80.0    # chamfer angle measured from horizontal

chamfer_dx = chamfer_h / math.tan(math.radians(chamfer_angle))

# ---- Build the U cross-section in the XY plane ----
outer = Rectangle(outer_width, height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

inner_w = outer_width - 2 * wall_thk
inner_h = height - base_thk
inner = Pos(0, base_thk) * Rectangle(inner_w, inner_h,
                                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

profile = outer - inner

# ---- Chamfer the inner top edges of both side walls ----
x_in = inner_w / 2  # inner face location (material lies beyond this)

tri_right = Polygon(
    (x_in, height),
    (x_in + chamfer_dx, height),
    (x_in, height - chamfer_h),
    align=None,
)
tri_left = Polygon(
    (-x_in, height),
    (-x_in - chamfer_dx, height),
    (-x_in, height - chamfer_h),
    align=None,
)

profile = profile - tri_right - tri_left

# ---- Extrude along +Z to form the channel ----
part = extrude(profile, amount=length)

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
length       = 80.0     # overall length
width        = 9.7      # bar width (Y)
height       = 8.3      # bar height (Z)

end_round    = height / 2.0   # 2x R4.1 -> full round on +X end
end_hole_x   = 75.9           # Ø4.1 hole centre, from -X end
end_hole_d   = 4.1

slot_w       = 4.8      # slot width
slot_depth   = 2.8      # slot depth along X
pin_hole_d   = 2.8      # Ø2.8 through hole
pin_hole_x   = 2.8      # its centre from the -X end
left_r       = 2.8      # R2.8 rounds on the -X end

# ---------------- base bar ----------------
part = Box(length, width, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

# full round on the +X end
right_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).group_by(Axis.X)[-1]
part = fillet(right_edges, radius=end_round)

# Ø4.1 through hole in the rounded end (vertical)
part -= Pos(end_hole_x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(end_hole_d / 2, height * 4)

# slot in the -X end: 4.8 wide, 2.8 deep, through the height
slot = Pos((slot_depth - 1.0) / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(slot_depth + 1.0, slot_w, height * 4)
part -= slot

# Ø2.8 through hole near the -X end (vertical)
part -= Pos(pin_hole_x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(pin_hole_d / 2, height * 4)

# R2.8 rounds on the -X end top/bottom edges
try:
    left_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).group_by(Axis.X)[0]
    part = fillet(left_edges, radius=left_r)
except Exception:
    pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
L = 80.0            # overall length
W = 8.3             # body width
T = 4.1             # body thickness
R_END = 4.1         # full-round radius of the pivot end (2x R4.1)
END_HOLE_X = 75.9   # pivot hole centre from the fork end
D_END = 2.8         # pivot-end through hole

FORK_L = 12.0       # length of the clevis end
FORK_W = 9.7        # clevis overall width
SLOT_W = 4.8        # clevis slot width
D_PIN = 4.1         # clevis pin hole
PIN_X = 6.0         # pin hole position from the end

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- main body with full-round end ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(L - R_END, W, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER))
        with Locations((L - R_END, 0)):
            Circle(R_END)
    extrude(amount=T)

    # ---- clevis boss (9.7 wide) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((FORK_L / 2, 0)):
            Rectangle(FORK_L, FORK_W)
    extrude(amount=T, mode=Mode.ADD)

    # ---- clevis slot (4.8 wide) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((FORK_L / 2 - 1.0, 0)):
            Rectangle(FORK_L + 2.0, SLOT_W)
    extrude(amount=T, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Ø4.1 pin hole through both prongs ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((PIN_X, T / 2)):
            Circle(D_PIN / 2)
    extrude(amount=FORK_W / 2 + 1, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Ø2.8 through hole at the pivot end ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((END_HOLE_X, 0)):
            Circle(D_END / 2)
    extrude(amount=T, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
DISC_D      = 80.0     # Ø80 disc
THK         = 6.0      # 6 thick
BORE_D      = 16.0     # Ø16 center bore
PIN_D       = 3.0      # Ø3 thru hole
NOTCH_OPEN  = 70.0     # notch vertical opening at the rim
NOTCH_DEPTH = 30.0     # deepest point of notch from disc center
PIN_FROM_TIP = 40.0    # pin hole located 40 from notch inner tip

disc_r    = DISC_D / 2.0
half_open = NOTCH_OPEN / 2.0

# notch cutter: circle centered on X axis, deepest point at (NOTCH_DEPTH, 0)
# and intersecting the rim where |y| = NOTCH_OPEN/2
x0 = sqrt(disc_r**2 - half_open**2)                       # rim x at y = ±35
c  = (NOTCH_DEPTH**2 - x0**2 - half_open**2) / (2.0 * (NOTCH_DEPTH - x0))
R  = NOTCH_DEPTH - c                                      # cutter radius

pin_x = NOTCH_DEPTH - PIN_FROM_TIP                        # pin hole x position
pin_y = 13.0                                              # pin hole y position

# ---------------- build ----------------

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        Circle(disc_r)                                    # disc outline

            Circle(R, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)                 # notch cutout

    with Locations((pin_x, pin_y, 0)):
        Cylinder(PIN_D / 2.0, THK * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# --- Dimensions from the drawing -------------------------------------------
outer_dia       = 75.4   # main outer diameter (front)
length          = 14.8   # overall length
small_outer_dia = 70.0   # outer diameter at the back (tapered body)
bore_dia        = 60.4   # through bore

cbore_depth     = 3.0    # counterbore depth
back_land       = 2.0    # short straight land at the back
front_land      = 3.0    # straight outer land at the front

r_bore  = bore_dia / 2
r_cbore = cbore_dia / 2
r_small = small_outer_dia / 2
r_out   = outer_dia / 2

# --- Revolved profile (radius, height) in the XZ plane ----------------------
profile = [
    (r_bore,  cbore_depth),          # counterbore bottom
    (r_cbore, cbore_depth),          # counterbore wall
    (r_cbore, 0.0),                  # rear face at counterbore
    (r_small, 0.0),                  # rear face outer
    (r_small, back_land),            # short back land
    (r_out,   length - front_land),  # tapered outer surface
    (r_out,   length),               # front land
    (r_bore,  length),               # front face to bore
    (r_bore,  cbore_depth),          # bore wall (close loop)
]

with BuildPart() as ring:

bore_r = bore_dia / 2
back_r = back_dia / 2

                (bore_r, z_back),
                (back_r, z_back),
                (outer_r, z_back + chamfer_axial),
                (outer_r, z_front),
                (bore_r, z_front),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

export_step(part, "output.step")

from math import tan, radians

# ---- dimensions from drawing ----
length      = 89.0     # extrusion length
width       = 17.1     # cross-section width  (X)
depth       = 22.9     # cross-section height (Y)
wall        = 2.0      # uniform wall thickness
cham_outer  = 8.6      # outer corner chamfer leg
cham_inner  = 6.9      # inner corner chamfer leg
ang         = 18.4     # chamfer angle from vertical (deg)

t = tan(radians(ang))

# ---- outer pentagon (origin at bottom centre) ----
hw = width / 2.0
outer_bottom_hw = hw - cham_outer * t
outer_pts = [
    (-hw, depth),
    ( hw, depth),
    ( hw, cham_outer),
    ( outer_bottom_hw, 0.0),
    (-outer_bottom_hw, 0.0),
    (-hw, cham_outer),
]

# ---- inner (cavity) pentagon, wall = 2 all around ----
ihw = hw - wall
inner_bottom_hw = ihw - cham_inner * t
inner_pts = [
    (-ihw, depth - wall),
    ( ihw, depth - wall),
    ( ihw, wall + cham_inner),
    ( inner_bottom_hw, wall),
    (-inner_bottom_hw, wall),
    (-ihw, wall + cham_inner),
]

# ---- build the hollow prism ----
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*outer_pts, close=True)
        make_face()
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*inner_pts, close=True)
        make_face(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=length)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- dimensions from drawing ----
W = 17.1          # outer width (X) of cross-section
D = 22.9          # outer depth (Y) of cross-section
H = 89.0          # length
t = 2.0           # wall thickness
ang = 18.4        # chamfer angle (from the side face)
leg_out = 8.6     # outer chamfer leg along side edge (2x 8.6 x 18.4°)
leg_in = 6.9      # inner chamfer leg (2x 6.9 x 18.4°) - results from 2mm offset

hx, hy = W / 2.0, D / 2.0
hl = leg_out * math.tan(math.radians(ang))   # horizontal leg of chamfer

# ---- outer hexagon (chamfers at bottom corners) ----
outer_pts = [
    (-hx,        hy),
    ( hx,        hy),
    ( hx,       -hy + leg_out),
    ( hx - hl,  -hy),
    (-hx + hl,  -hy),
    (-hx,       -hy + leg_out),
]

# ---- inner profile: exact 2mm parallel offset of outer ----
a, b = leg_out, hl
L = math.hypot(a, b)
# left chamfer line: a*x + b*y = c0 ; offset inward by t -> c1
c0 = a * (-hx) + b * (-hy + leg_out)
c1 = c0 + t * L

ix, iy = hx - t, hy - t
y1 = (c1 + a * ix) / b          # inner chamfer meets inner side edge x = -ix
x1 = (c1 + b * iy) / a          # inner chamfer meets inner bottom edge y = -iy

inner_pts = [
    (-ix,  iy),
    ( ix,  iy),
    ( ix,  y1),
    (-x1, -iy),
    ( x1, -iy),
    (-ix,  y1),
]

# ---- build ----
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*outer_pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=H)

    extrude(amount=H, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
from math import sin, cos, radians

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
W = 17.1     # overall width of cross-section
H = 22.9     # overall depth of cross-section
L = 80.0     # extrusion length
T = 2.0      # wall thickness
CH = 8.6     # chamfer length (outer face), 2 places
ANG = 18.4   # chamfer angle measured from the vertical sides

a = radians(ANG)
dx = CH * sin(a)   # horizontal leg of the chamfer
dy = CH * cos(a)   # vertical leg of the chamfer

# outer profile (bottom corners chamfered)
outer = [
    (dx, 0.0),
    (W - dx, 0.0),
    (W, dy),
    (W, H),
    (0.0, H),
    (0.0, dy),
]

# inner profile = outer profile offset inward by the wall thickness
yi = dy + T * (1 - cos(a)) / sin(a)      # chamfer meets inner side wall
xi = (T - (T - dy) * sin(a)) / cos(a)    # chamfer meets inner bottom wall
inner = [
    (xi, T),
    (W - xi, T),
    (W - T, yi),
    (W - T, H - T),
    (T, H - T),
    (T, yi),
]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*outer, close=True)
        make_face()
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*inner, close=True)
        make_face(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=L)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
width = 17.1          # outer profile width  (top view)
depth = 22.9          # outer profile depth  (side view)
length = 80.0         # tube length
wall = 2.0            # wall thickness

cham_angle = 18.4     # chamfer angle (deg)
outer_leg = 6.9       # 2x 6.9 x 18.4°
inner_leg = 8.6       # 2x 8.6 x 18.4°

t = math.tan(math.radians(cham_angle))

half_w = width / 2.0
outer_off = outer_leg * t          # horizontal run of outer chamfer
inner_off = inner_leg * t          # horizontal run of inner chamfer
inner_half_w = half_w - wall

# ---- outer profile (y = 0 at chamfered face) ----
outer_pts = [
    (-half_w + outer_off, 0.0),
    (-half_w, outer_leg),
    (-half_w, depth),
    (half_w, depth),
    (half_w, outer_leg),
    (half_w - outer_off, 0.0),
]

# ---- inner profile ----
inner_pts = [
    (-inner_half_w + inner_off, wall),
    (-inner_half_w, wall + inner_leg),
    (-inner_half_w, depth - wall),
    (inner_half_w, depth - wall),
    (inner_half_w, wall + inner_leg),
    (inner_half_w - inner_off, wall),
]

# ---- build ----
outer_face = Polygon(*outer_pts, align=None)
inner_face = Polygon(*inner_pts, align=None)

part = extrude(outer_face, amount=length) - extrude(inner_face, amount=length)
part.label = "AEROSPACE-7991"

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions (mm) ----
W = 9.7            # body width (front view)
T = 7.2            # thickness (side view)
L = 80.0           # overall length
STEM_H = 11.0      # stem height from bottom
STEM_W = 5.6       # stem square width
R_STEM = 2.8       # stem end full radius
R_NECK = 1.4       # 4x neck fillets where stem meets body
R_TOP = 4.1        # 4x top corner radius
SLOT_W = 2.4       # fork slot width
SLOT_BOT = 66.2    # slot bottom from part bottom

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- 2D profile in XZ plane (side silhouette) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        # body rectangle
        with Locations((0, STEM_H)):
            Rectangle(W, L - STEM_H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        # stem rectangle
        with Locations((0, 0)):
            Rectangle(STEM_W, STEM_H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

        # 4x R4.1 top corners
        top_v = sk.vertices().filter_by(lambda v: abs(v.Y - L) < 0.01)
        fillet(top_v, R_TOP)

        # 4x R1.4 neck fillets
        neck_v = sk.vertices().filter_by(
            lambda v: abs(v.Y - STEM_H) < 0.01
            and abs(abs(v.X) - STEM_W / 2) < 0.01)
        fillet(neck_v, R_NECK)

        # R2.8 stem end round
        bot_v = sk.vertices().filter_by(lambda v: abs(v.Y) < 0.01)
        fillet(bot_v, R_STEM)

    # ---- extrude to full thickness (centered on Y=0) ----
    extrude(amount=T / 2, both=True)

    # ---- fork slot at top (2.4 wide in Y, cuts through full X) ----
    with Locations((0, 0, SLOT_BOT)):
        Box(W + 2.0, SLOT_W, L - SLOT_BOT + 2.0,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
from math import sqrt, cos, asin, degrees

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions read from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
W     = 68.9      # plate width (plan view)
L     = 80.0      # overall chord length of the curved plate (front view)
H     = 16.4      # overall height of the curved plate (front view)
T     = 8.0       # plate thickness (radial section)
CHAM  = 4.0       # C4 chamfer

# through holes: (from left edge of plan view, from left end, diameter)
holes = [
    (34.5, 24.0, 6.2),    # Ø6.2  THRU
    (48.4, 40.0, 8.8),    # Ø8.8  THRU
    (26.5, 52.8, 15.5),   # Ø15.5 THRU
    (26.5, 62.8, 7.7),    # Ø7.7  THRU
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve outer radius so that overall height = 16.4
#   height(Ro) = Ro - (Ro - T)*cos(asin((L/2)/Ro))
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def profile_height(ro):
    return ro - (ro - T) * cos(asin((L / 2) / ro))

lo, hi = 60.0, 1000.0
for _ in range(200):
    mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    if profile_height(mid) > H:
        lo = mid
    else:
        hi = mid
R_outer = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
R_inner = R_outer - T
half_ang = degrees(asin((L / 2) / R_outer))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Curved plate: annular sector extruded across the width
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as plate:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            outer = CenterArc((0, 0), R_outer, 90 - half_ang, 2 * half_ang)
            inner = CenterArc((0, 0), R_inner, 90 + half_ang, -2 * half_ang)
            Line(outer @ 1, inner @ 0)
            Line(inner @ 1, outer @ 0)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=W)

    # C4 chamfer on the four edges bounding the convex face
    chamfer(
        plate.edges().filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(sqrt(e.center().X ** 2 + e.center().Z ** 2) - R_outer) < 1e-3
        ),
        length=CHAM,
    )

part = plate.part

# centre the plate on its own width
bb = part.bounding_box()
part = part.moved(Location((0, -(bb.min.Y + bb.max.Y) / 2.0, 0)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Radial through holes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
r_mid = 0.5 * (R_outer + R_inner)
for u_left, v_left, dia in holes:
    hx = -L / 2.0 + v_left            # position along the chord
    hy = -W / 2.0 + u_left            # position across the width
    hz = sqrt(max(r_mid ** 2 - hx ** 2, 0.0))
    axis = Vector(hx, 0, hz).normalized()
    hp = Plane(origin=(hx, hy, hz), z_dir=axis)
    part = part - hp * Cylinder(dia / 2.0, 4.0 * T)

export_step(part, "output.step")

thickness   = 16.4      # wall thickness (Z)

chamfer_sz  = 4.0       # C4

    (24.0, 26.5, 7.7),
    (40.0, 34.5, 15.5),
    (52.8, 48.4, 8.8),
    (62.8, 48.4, 6.2),
]

# ---------------- curved cross-section ----------------
half_ang = math.asin((chord / 2) / R_out)
cos_h    = math.cos(half_ang)

y_out = chord / 2                       # outer arc half-chord
y_in  = R_in * math.sin(half_ang)       # inner arc half-chord
z_out = R_out * (1 - cos_h)             # outer arc sagitta
z_in  = R_out - R_in * cos_h            # inner arc height at ends

with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
    with BuildLine():
        ThreePointArc((-y_out, z_out), (0, 0), (y_out, z_out))
        Line((y_out, z_out), (y_in, z_in))
        ThreePointArc((y_in, z_in), (0, thickness), (-y_in, z_in))
        Line((-y_in, z_in), (-y_out, z_out))
    make_face()

part = extrude(sk.sketch, amount=length / 2, both=True)

# ---------------- C4 chamfer on both end faces ----------------
groups    = part.edges().group_by(Axis.X)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------- dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----------------
plate_len = 80.0      # chord length of the curved plate
plate_wid = 68.9      # width of the plate
sagitta   = 16.4      # rise of the curved plate
thk       = 6.0       # plate wall thickness
cham      = 4.0       # "C4" chamfer

# through holes: (position along length, position across width, dia)
holes = [
    (24.0,  26.5, 7.7),    # Ø7.7 THRU
    (40.0,  34.5, 15.5),   # Ø15.5 THRU
    (52.8,  48.4, 8.8),    # Ø8.8 THRU
    (62.8,  41.0, 6.2),    # Ø6.2 THRU
]

# ---------------- arc geometry (XZ profile) ----------------
R    = plate_len**2 / (8.0 * sagitta) + sagitta / 2.0
cx   = plate_len / 2.0
cz   = sagitta - R
half = math.degrees(math.asin((plate_len / 2.0) / R))
a1   = 90.0 - half
a2   = 90.0 + half
Ri   = R - thk

def pt(rad, ang):
    return (cx + rad * math.cos(math.radians(ang)),
            cz + rad * math.sin(math.radians(ang)))

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # curved plate cross-section, extruded across the width
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            CenterArc((cx, cz), R, a1, a2 - a1)
            Line(pt(R, a2), pt(Ri, a2))
            CenterArc((cx, cz), Ri, a2, -(a2 - a1))
            Line(pt(Ri, a1), pt(R, a1))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_wid / 2.0, both=True)

    # through holes, drilled normal to the curved surface
    for hx, hy, hd in holes:
        phi = math.asin((hx - cx) / R)
        Rm  = R - thk / 2.0
        loc = Location((cx + Rm * math.sin(phi),
                        hy - plate_wid / 2.0,
                        cz + Rm * math.cos(phi))) * Rotation(0, math.degrees(phi), 0)
        with Locations(loc):
            Cylinder(hd / 2.0, 40.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # C4 chamfer — pick the Y-parallel corner edge on the right-hand end
    y_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
    target  = max(y_edges, key=lambda e: (e.center().X, e.center().Z))
    chamfer(target, cham)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

L = 80.0          # length (X)

R_IN = 7.2        # inside fillet wall/base
R_OUT = 4.8       # outside bottom-back edge
R_VERT = 7.2      # vertical corner radius of base
HOLE_D = 21.6     # cross hole diameter

# ---- Base + wall ----
base = Box(L, D, BASE_T, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
wall = Box(L, WALL_T, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
part = base + wall

# ---- Step cut on top of wall (right end) ----
part -= Pos(STEP_X, -1.0, H - STEP_H) * Box(
    L - STEP_X + 1.0, WALL_T + 2.0, STEP_H + 1.0,
    align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---- Inside fillet where wall meets base ----
inner = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Y - WALL_T) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Z - BASE_T) < 1e-6)
part = fillet(inner, R_IN)

# ---- Outside radius on the back bottom edge ----
outer = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Y) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6)
part = fillet(outer, R_OUT)

# ---- Rounded vertical corner of the base ----

    lambda e: abs(e.center().X) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Y - D) < 1e-6)

# Dimensions from drawing (mm)
THICKNESS = 14.3        # A/F, part thickness
WIDTH = 45.7            # overall width/depth
HEIGHT = 80.0           # overall height
SLOT_W = 14.3           # central slot width

FILLET_R = 7.4          # 4x R7.4

block = Box(WIDTH, HEIGHT, THICKNESS)

# Central rounded slot profile in XY plane, cut through thickness
def slot_profile(width: float, length: float):
    r = width / 2
    straight = length - width
    profile = Rectangle(width, straight)
    profile += Pos(0, straight / 2) * Circle(r)
    profile += Pos(0, -straight / 2) * Circle(r)
    return profile

slot_cutter = extrude(slot_profile(SLOT_W, SLOT_L), amount=THICKNESS * 2, both=True)
part = block - slot_cutter

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- overall dimensions ----------------
W, H, T = 40.0, 80.0, 16.0

# ---------------- cavity profile dimensions ----------------
hh  = 73.2 / 2          # 36.6  half height of cavity profile
cr  = 4.0               # R4.0  corner rounds
wx  = 10.5              # half-width of cavity
nr  = 4.0               # R4.0  side bulges
cy  = 18.0              # bulge / chevron centre height
tr  = 3.6               # R3.6  chevron tip radius

# Exact tangency geometry for chevron tip (120 deg arc)
theta = math.radians(60)                 # half arc of tip
tx    = tr * math.cos(theta)             # 1.8  tangent point X
ty    = tr * math.sin(theta)             # 3.11769 tangent offset Y
slope = math.tan(math.radians(30))       # 0.57735 (cot 60)
y_off = ty + slope * (tx + wx)           # 10.219  wall connection offset

# ---------------- build part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    Box(W, H, T)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            # top edge and top-right corner
            Line((-wx + cr, hh), (wx - cr, hh))
            CenterArc((wx - cr, hh - cr), cr, 90, -90)

            # right wall (down) with two R4.0 bulges
            Line((wx, hh - cr), (wx, cy + nr))
            CenterArc((wx, cy), nr, 90, -180)
            Line((wx, cy - nr), (wx, -cy + nr))
            CenterArc((wx, -cy), nr, 90, -180)
            Line((wx, -cy - nr), (wx, -(hh - cr)))

            # bottom-right corner, bottom edge, bottom-left corner
            CenterArc((wx - cr, -(hh - cr)), cr, 0, -90)
            Line((wx - cr, -hh), (-wx + cr, -hh))
            CenterArc((-wx + cr, -(hh - cr)), cr, -90, -90)

            # left wall, lower chevron
            Line((-wx, -(hh - cr)), (-wx, -(cy + y_off)))
            Line((-wx, -(cy + y_off)), (tx, -(cy + ty)))
            CenterArc((0, -cy), tr, -60, 120)
            Line((tx, -(cy - ty)), (-wx, -(cy - y_off)))

            # left wall between chevrons
            Line((-wx, -(cy - y_off)), (-wx, cy - y_off))

            # left wall, upper chevron
            Line((-wx, cy - y_off), (tx, cy - ty))
            CenterArc((0, cy), tr, -60, 120)
            Line((tx, cy + ty), (-wx, cy + y_off))

            # upper left wall and top-left corner
            Line((-wx, cy + y_off), (-wx, hh - cr))
            CenterArc((-wx + cr, hh - cr), cr, 180, -90)

        make_face()

from build123d import *
from math import cos, pi

# ---------------- dimensions ----------------
W = 40.0          # overall width  (X)
H = 80.0          # overall height (Y)
T = 16.0          # thickness      (Z)

POCKET_H = 73.2   # height of wavy pocket
TIP_R    = 3.6    # R3.6 chevron point radius
WAVE_R   = 4.0    # R4.0 pocket / wave radii

py0 = (H - POCKET_H) / 2.0     # 3.4
py1 = py0 + POCKET_H           # 76.6


def wavy_profile(xl, xt, xc, amp, y0, y1, n=24, periods=3):
    """Closed pocket profile: flat top, wavy right edge, flat bottom, chevron left."""
    cy = (y0 + y1) / 2.0
    xr = xc + amp
    # wavy right edge, sampled top -> bottom (starts at a crest)
    pts = [(xc + amp * cos(2 * pi * periods * i / n), y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / n)
           for i in range(n + 1)][::-1]

    e_top = Line((xl, y1), (xr, y1))
    e_wav = Spline(*pts)
    e_bot = Line((xr, y0), (xl, y0))
    e_ldn = Line((xl, y0), (xt, cy))
    e_lup = Line((xt, cy), (xl, y1))
    face = make_face([e_top, e_wav, e_bot, e_ldn, e_lup])

    tip = face.vertices().filter_by(
        lambda v: abs(v.X - xt) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - cy) < 1e-6)
    face = fillet(tip, radius=TIP_R)

    crn = face.vertices().filter_by(
        lambda v: abs(v.X - xr) < 1e-6 and
        (abs(v.Y - y1) < 1e-6 or abs(v.Y - y0) < 1e-6))
    face = fillet(crn, radius=WAVE_R)
    return face


# front (full size) pocket profile and the smaller rear profile
big = wavy_profile(xl=9.0, xt=20.0, xc=32.0, amp=2.0, y0=py0, y1=py1)
small = wavy_profile(xl=12.0, xt=19.0, xc=31.0, amp=1.5,
                     y0=py0 + 2.0, y1=py1 - 2.0)

# ---------------- solid ----------------
block = Box(W, H, T, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# rear half : small wavy through opening
part = block - extrude(small, amount=T)

# front half : full size wavy pocket (creates the internal shoulder)
part = part - extrude(Pos(0, 0, T / 2) * big, amount=T / 2)

part = part.clean()

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------- dimensions (mm) ----------
rod_dia  = 5.4      # main rod diameter  (end view)
rod_len  = 80.0     # overall rod length (side view)
pin_dia  = 2.2      # cross-pin wire diameter
pin_len  = 9.1      # cross-pin overall length, tip to tip (end view)
pin1_x   = 25.0     # first cross pin, from left end
pin2_x   = 50.1     # second cross pin, from left end

# ---------- main rod, along +X from origin ----------
rod = Pos(rod_len / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(rod_dia / 2, rod_len)

# ---------- cross pin: two perpendicular wires through the rod ----------
def cross_pin(x):
    arm_y = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(pin_dia / 2, pin_len)  # along Y
    arm_z = Cylinder(pin_dia / 2, pin_len)                  # along Z
    return Pos(x, 0, 0) * (arm_y + arm_z)

# ---------- assemble ----------
part = rod + cross_pin(pin1_x) + cross_pin(pin2_x)

export_step(part, "output.step")

D = 37.3      # depth  (Y)
H = 80.0      # height (Z)

# ---------------- Top features ----------------

SLOT_W   = 6.2          # top slot width
SLOT_H   = 5.3          # top slot depth
WALL     = (W - 2 * GROOVE_R - 2 * SLOT_W) / 2   # remaining outer wall = 8.95

# ---------------- Bottom features ----------------
NOTCH_W  = 8.9          # front notch width
NOTCH_H  = 24.0         # notch / recess height
RECESS_W = NOTCH_W + 2 * 5.3   # 19.5 hidden inner recess width
RECESS_D = 5.3          # recess depth from back face
LEFT     = 5.3          # recess offset from left face

# ---------------- Base block ----------------
part = Box(W, D, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- Top semicircular groove (axis along Y, full depth) -----
groove = Pos(W / 2, D / 2, H) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(GROOVE_R, D)
part -= groove

# ---------------- Two top slots flanking the groove (full depth) ---------
for x0 in (WALL, W - WALL - SLOT_W):
    part -= Pos(x0, 0, H - SLOT_H) * Box(
        SLOT_W, D, SLOT_H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN)
    )

# ---------------- Bottom front notch (through most of the depth) ---------
part -= Pos(LEFT + (RECESS_W - NOTCH_W) / 2, 0, 0) * Box(
    NOTCH_W, D - RECESS_D, NOTCH_H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN)
)

# ---------------- Hidden inner recess at the back ------------------------
part -= Pos(LEFT, D - RECESS_D, 0) * Box(
    RECESS_W, RECESS_D, NOTCH_H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN)
)

export_step(part, "output.step")

top_edge_angle = -5.0     # top face slopes down 5° to the right (175° to horizontal)
right_face_angle = 155.0  # right face leans left (interior angle 25°)

# Compute profile points in the XZ plane
x1, z1 = 0.0, 0.0
x2 = height_left / math.tan(math.radians(left_face_angle))
z2 = height_left
x4, z4 = length, 0.0

m1 = math.tan(math.radians(top_edge_angle))
m2 = math.tan(math.radians(right_face_angle))
x3 = (z4 - z2 + m1 * x2 - m2 * x4) / (m1 - m2)
z3 = z2 + m1 * (x3 - x2)

print(f"Profile points: ({x1},{z1}), ({x2:.4f},{z2}), ({x3:.4f},{z3:.4f}), ({x4},{z4})")

# Build the part
with BuildPart() as part_bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((x1, z1), (x2, z2), (x3, z3), (x4, z4), close=True)

pts = [(R * math.cos(math.radians(60 * i)),

            Polyline(*pts, close=True)

import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
across_corners = 10.0          # top view, across corner vertices
total_length   = 80.0          # overall length
taper_length   = 20.0          # tapered point length (front / ISO view)
tip_x_scale    = 0.5           # tip flat edge = half of across-corners
tip_thickness  = 0.01          # tip collapses to an (almost) line in Y
fillet_radius  = 0.7           # 4x / 2x R0.7 on the bottom end

body_length = total_length - taper_length

# ---- hexagon cross section (vertices on the X axis -> flat top/bottom) ----
R = across_corners / 2.0
hex_pts = [(R * math.cos(math.radians(60 * i)),
            R * math.sin(math.radians(60 * i))) for i in range(6)]

# tip cross section: scaled 1/2 in X, collapsed to ~0 in Y
max_y = R * math.sin(math.radians(60))
tip_y_scale = (tip_thickness / 2.0) / max_y
tip_pts = [(x * tip_x_scale, y * tip_y_scale) for (x, y) in hex_pts]

# ---- straight hexagonal body ----
body = extrude(Plane.XY * Polygon(*hex_pts, align=None), amount=body_length)

# ---- tapered point (loft from hexagon down to the short tip edge) ----
sec_bottom = Plane.XY.offset(body_length) * Polygon(*hex_pts, align=None)
sec_top    = Plane.XY.offset(total_length) * Polygon(*tip_pts, align=None)
taper = loft([sec_bottom, sec_top])

part = body + taper

# ---- R0.7 rounds on the blunt (bottom) end ----
bottom_edges = part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
part = fillet(bottom_edges, radius=fillet_radius)

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import cos, radians

# Given dimensions
total_length = 80.0
hex_across_flats = 10.0
blade_width = 8.7
corner_radius = 0.7

# Inferred / assumed dimensions (not explicitly dimensioned on the drawing)
blade_thickness = 4.0     # thickness of the flat blade
bevel_length = 5.0        # length of the chisel bevel
body_length = 60.0        # length of the parallel blade body
taper_length = 10.0       # length of the transition from hex shank to blade
hex_length = 5.0          # length of the hexagonal shank (80 - 5 - 60 - 10 = 5)

# Derived values
hex_circumradius = hex_across_flats / (2 * cos(radians(30)))
body_start_z = bevel_length
body_end_z = bevel_length + body_length
taper_start_z = body_end_z
taper_end_z = taper_start_z + taper_length
hex_start_z = taper_end_z
hex_end_z = total_length

# 1. Hexagonal shank (top of part)
hex_face = Plane.XY.offset(hex_start_z) * RegularPolygon(radius=hex_circumradius, side_count=6)
hex_prism = extrude(hex_face, amount=hex_length)

# 2. Taper from hex down to rectangular blade cross-section
taper_rect_face = Plane.XY.offset(taper_start_z) * Rectangle(blade_width, blade_thickness)
taper = loft([hex_face, taper_rect_face])

# 3. Rectangular blade body
body = extrude(taper_rect_face, amount=body_length)

# 4. Chisel tip (before beveling)
tip_rect_face = Plane.XY.offset(body_start_z) * Rectangle(blade_width, blade_thickness)
tip = extrude(tip_rect_face, amount=bevel_length)

# Combine all segments
part = hex_prism + taper + body + tip

# 5. Fillet the four long edges of the rectangular blade (R0.7)
long_edges = []
for e in part.edges():
    if e.length > 20:          # blade edges are ~60 mm, hex edges are 5 mm
        v = e.tangent_at(0)
        if abs(v.Z) > 0.9:     # parallel to Z axis
            long_edges.append(e)
part = fillet(long_edges, radius=corner_radius)

# 6. Cut the chisel bevels at the bottom (Z = 0 to Z = bevel_length)
# Front bevel (negative Y side)
front_poly = Polygon(
    (-blade_thickness/2, 0),
    (-blade_thickness/2, bevel_length),
    (0, 0),
    align=None
)
front_face = Plane.YZ * front_poly
front_cut = extrude(front_face, amount=blade_width/2, both=True)

# Back bevel (positive Y side)
back_poly = Polygon(
    (0, 0),
    (0, bevel_length),
    (blade_thickness/2, bevel_length),
    align=None
)
back_face = Plane.YZ * back_poly
back_cut = extrude(back_face, amount=blade_width/2, both=True)

part = part - front_cut - back_cut

# Export the final solid
export_step(part, "output.step")
