from build123d import *
from math import cos, sin, radians

# ---------------- dimensions ----------------
AF = 10.0        # hexagon across flats
L = 80.0         # overall length
FIL = 0.7        # bottom corner radius (4x / 2x R0.7)
RC = AF / 2 / cos(radians(30))   # hexagon circumradius (5.7735)

Y_TAPER_START = 55.0   # where the long taper (to the point) starts
X_TAPER_START = 72.0   # where the short blade taper starts
TIP_HALF = 0.75        # half thickness of the chisel tip

# ---------------- hex bar ----------------
pts = [(RC * cos(radians(a)), RC * sin(radians(a))) for a in range(30, 390, 60)]
profile = Polygon(*pts, align=None)
part = extrude(profile, amount=L)

# ---------------- long taper cutter (Y direction, forms the point) ----------
far = 500.0
slope = RC / (L - Y_TAPER_START)
y_far = RC - slope * (far - Y_TAPER_START)
pts2d = [(RC, Y_TAPER_START), (y_far, far), (y_far, far + 200), (200.0, far + 200), (200.0, Y_TAPER_START)]
cutter_y = extrude(Plane.YZ * Polygon(*pts2d, align=None), amount=60, both=True)
part -= cutter_y
part -= mirror(cutter_y, Plane.XZ)

# ---------------- blade cutter (X direction, forms the flat chisel tip) -----
slope = (AF / 2 - TIP_HALF) / (L - X_TAPER_START)
x_far = AF / 2 - slope * (far - X_TAPER_START)
pts2d = [(AF / 2, X_TAPER_START), (x_far, far), (x_far, far + 200), (200.0, far + 200), (200.0, X_TAPER_START)]
cutter_x = extrude(Plane.XZ * Polygon(*pts2d, align=None), amount=60, both=True)
part -= cutter_x
part -= mirror(cutter_x, Plane.YZ)

# ---------------- bottom corner radii (4x R0.7 + 2x R0.7) -------------------
bottom_edges = part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
part = fillet(bottom_edges, radius=FIL)

bolt_circle = 83.0     # bolt circle diameter

        Rectangle(plate_size, plate_size)
        fillet(sk.vertices(), radius=corner_r)
    extrude(amount=plate_thk)

    # cylindrical boss on the front face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thk)):
        Circle(radius=boss_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=boss_len)

    # central through hole
    with Locations(Plane.XY.offset((plate_thk + boss_len) / 2)):

        Cylinder(radius=bolt_hole_d / 2,

import math

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
body_len    = 50.8      # length of square body
body_size   = 80.0      # square face size
corner_r    = 6.8       # 4x R6.8 corner radii
boss_dia    = 49.8      # pilot boss diameter
boss_len    = 12.5      # boss protrusion length
shaft_dia   = 13.6      # shaft diameter
shaft_len   = 5.0       # shaft protrusion beyond boss
bore_dia    = 11.3      # central through hole
hole_dia    = 6.8       # 4x mounting holes
hole_bc     = 83.0      # bolt circle diameter

# mounting hole positions (equally spaced on bolt circle at 45 deg)
c = (hole_bc / 2.0) / math.sqrt(2.0)

with BuildPart() as motor:
    # square body with rounded corners
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as body_sk:
        Rectangle(body_size, body_size)
        fillet(body_sk.vertices(), radius=corner_r)
    extrude(amount=body_len)

    # boss / pilot
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(body_len)):
        Circle(boss_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=boss_len)

    # shaft
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(body_len + boss_len)):
        Circle(shaft_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=shaft_len)

    # central through bore
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Circle(bore_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=body_len + boss_len + shaft_len, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        with Locations((c, c), (-c, c), (c, -c), (-c, -c)):
            Circle(hole_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=body_len, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(part, "output.step")

depth = 80.0              # overall depth  (Y)  -> dimension "80"

# Top face is a single inclined plane.
# Front-left edge is the highest point (73.2), it falls toward
# the right (front view) and toward the back (side view).
height_right_front = 61.2  # top of front face at the right end
height_left_back = 15.0    # top of back face at the left end

# Rectangular slot in the bottom (through the full depth)
slot_x_min = 21.0
slot_x_max = 54.0
slot_height = 27.0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Base block 75.4 x 80 x 73.2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
part = Box(width, depth, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Inclined top face -> split with plane through the three points
#   (0,0,73.2) , (75.4,0,61.2) , (0,80,15.0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
p1 = Vector(0.0, 0.0, height)
p2 = Vector(width, 0.0, height_right_front)
p3 = Vector(0.0, depth, height_left_back)

normal = (p2 - p1).cross(p3 - p1)
top_plane = Plane(origin=p1, z_dir=normal)

part = split(part, bisect_by=top_plane, keep=Keep.BOTTOM)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Bottom slot (through slot, full depth)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
slot = Box(slot_x_max - slot_x_min, depth + 2.0, slot_height,
           align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
slot = Pos(slot_x_min, -1.0, -1.0) * slot
part = part - slot

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

wall_id     = 72.6      # wall bore diameter

tab_dia     = 24.2      # R12.1 tab / crescent
tab_off_y   = -32.7     # 32.7 basic location of the tab centre
tab_width   = 18.1      # 18.1 across the tab feature

gap_angle   = 90.0      # opening of the C-shaped wall (centred at -Y)

# ---- base flange ----
flange = Cylinder(flange_r, flange_t,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- C-shaped cylindrical wall ----
outer = Cylinder(wall_od / 2, wall_h,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
inner = Cylinder(wall_id / 2, wall_h,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
ring = outer - inner

# wedge that removes the 90 degree opening centred on -Y
rr = 100.0
a1 = math.radians(270.0 - gap_angle / 2)   # 225 deg
a2 = math.radians(270.0 + gap_angle / 2)   # 315 deg
wedge_pts = [(0.0, 0.0),
             (rr * math.cos(a1), rr * math.sin(a1)),
             (rr * math.cos(a2), rr * math.sin(a2))]
wedge = extrude(make_face(Polyline(*wedge_pts, close=True)), amount=wall_h)
ring = ring - wedge

# ---- small crescent tab standing in the opening ----
tab = Pos(0, tab_off_y, 0) * Cylinder(tab_dia / 2, total_h,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
clip = Cylinder(flange_r, total_h,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
tab = tab & clip

# ---- combine ----
part = flange + ring + tab

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import cos, radians

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
BODY_DIA   = 47.4          # main body diameter
BODY_R     = BODY_DIA / 2  # 23.7
BODY_LEN   = 44.0          # body length (along its own axis)
CHAM       = 12.7          # C12.7 chamfer on the outer end
HEX_AF     = 33.9          # hexagon across flats
HEX_LEN    = 18.7          # length of the hexagon section
CYL_LEN    = BODY_LEN - HEX_LEN          # 25.3

BORE_DIA   = 22.0          # main bore
BORE_DEPTH = 22.5          # bore depth from outer end face
SMALL_DIA  = 8.1           # small through hole

ROD_DIA    = 10.0          # lever handle diameter
ROD_REACH  = 56.3          # lever tip to body axis  (80 overall)

HEX_CR = (HEX_AF / 2) / cos(radians(30))  # circumscribed radius of hexagon

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part:  body axis = Z,  lever axis = X
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- hexagonal section (inner end of body) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(-BODY_LEN / 2)):
        RegularPolygon(radius=HEX_CR, side_count=6)
    extrude(amount=HEX_LEN)

    # ---- cylindrical section (outer end of body) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(-BODY_LEN / 2 + HEX_LEN)):
        Circle(BODY_R)
    extrude(amount=CYL_LEN)

    # ---- C12.7 chamfer on the outer circular edge ----
    outer_edge = bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    chamfer(outer_edge, length=CHAM)

    # ---- lever handle (rod) sticking out sideways ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Circle(ROD_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=-ROD_REACH)

    # ---- main bore, from the outer end face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(BODY_LEN / 2)):
        Circle(BORE_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=-BORE_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- small through hole ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(BODY_LEN / 2)):
        Circle(SMALL_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=-BODY_LEN, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# Dimension variables (mm)
rod_dia = 18.4
rod_len = 31.7
flange_dia = 47.4
flange_thick = 4.0
overall_len = 80.0
oct_af = 44.0                     # across flats of octagon
oct_len = overall_len - rod_len - flange_thick   # 44.3
cent_hole_dia = 22.0
small_hole_dia = 8.1
small_hole_y = 5.0                # from centre, based on 18.7 from top (47.4/2 - 18.7 = 5.0)
small_hole_z = 0.0
chamfer_size = 12.7

# Octagon circumradius from across-flats
oct_r = oct_af / (2 * math.cos(math.pi / 8))

# Build the solid
# 1. Handle rod (axis along X)
rod = Cylinder(rod_dia / 2, rod_len)
rod = rod.rotate(Axis.Y, 90).locate(Location((rod_len / 2, 0, 0)))

# 2. Circular flange (axis along X)
flange = Cylinder(flange_dia / 2, flange_thick)
flange = flange.rotate(Axis.Y, 90).locate(Location((rod_len + flange_thick / 2, 0, 0)))

# 3. Octagonal body (axis along X)
oct_sketch = Plane.YZ * RegularPolygon(oct_r, 8)
oct_body = extrude(oct_sketch, amount=oct_len)
oct_body = oct_body.locate(Location((rod_len + flange_thick, 0, 0)))

# Fuse the three main bodies
part = rod + flange + oct_body

# 4. Central hole through flange and octagonal body (not through rod)
hole_len = overall_len - rod_len
cent_hole = Cylinder(cent_hole_dia / 2, hole_len)
cent_hole = cent_hole.rotate(Axis.Y, 90).locate(Location((rod_len + hole_len / 2, 0, 0)))
part -= cent_hole

# 5. Small cross-hole (diameter 8.1) along X, located in the octagonal body
small_hole = Cylinder(small_hole_dia / 2, oct_len + 10)
small_hole = small_hole.rotate(Axis.Y, 90).locate(
    Location((rod_len + flange_thick + oct_len / 2, small_hole_y, small_hole_z))
)
part -= small_hole

# 6. Chamfer C12.7 on the right end face edges of the octagonal body
right_edges = part.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.center().X > overall_len - 1e-3)
part = chamfer(right_edges, length=chamfer_size)

# Export
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions from drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------
outer_dia      = 47.4          # circumscribed diameter of octagon
across_flats   = 44.0          # across flats of octagon
thickness      = 18.4          # main body thickness (from side view)
bore_dia       = 22.0          # central bore
boss_height    = 4.0           # boss height (4.0 HIGH)
small_hole_dia = 8.1           # small hole
handle_len     = 56.3          # handle length from center
overall_len    = 80.0          # overall length from handle end to far edge
handle_dia     = 12.7          # handle diameter (from C12.7 chamfer callout)
chamfer_size   = 12.7          # C12.7 chamfer

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Main octagonal prism (axis along Z)
octagon = RegularPolygon(radius=outer_dia/2, side_count=8)
main_body = extrude(octagon, amount=thickness)

# Central bore
bore = Cylinder(radius=bore_dia/2, height=thickness + 2* boss_height)
bore = Pos(0, 0, -boss_height) * bore
part = main_body - bore

# Boss on top face (octagonal shape, slightly smaller)
boss_oct = RegularPolygon(radius=across_flats/2, side_count=8)  # across-flats -> circumradius? 
# For a regular octagon, circumradius = across_flats / (2*cos(22.5°))
boss_radius = across_flats / (2 * math.cos(math.radians(22.5)))
boss_oct = RegularPolygon(radius=boss_radius, side_count=8)
boss = extrude(boss_oct, amount=boss_height)
boss = Pos(0, 0, thickness) * boss
part = part + boss

# Small hole in the boss
small_hole = Cylinder(radius=small_hole_dia/2, height=boss_height + 2)
small_hole = Pos(0, 0, thickness) * small_hole
part = part - small_hole

# Handle (rod) extending radially along -X
handle = Cylinder(radius=handle_dia/2, height=handle_len)
handle = Rot(0, 90, 0) * handle  # align along X
handle = Pos(-handle_len/2, 0, thickness/2) * handle
part = part + handle

# Optional chamfer on top edge
try:
    part = chamfer(part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1], chamfer_size)
except:
    pass

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------
part.label = "ORION-7154"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    ( width_bot / 2, h_bot),

    (-width_bot / 2 + width_top, height),
    (-width_bot / 2, height),
]

    for ang_deg in (0, 90, 180, 270):
        ang = math.radians(ang_deg)
        c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        local_pts = [

            ( notch_outer_w / 2, outer_radius + 3.0),
            (-notch_outer_w / 2, outer_radius + 3.0),

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (from drawing) ----------------
OD         = 82.8      # outside diameter
NOTCH_DIA  = 66.9      # diameter across jaw notch flats
THK        = 13.1      # plate thickness
BORE_DIA   = 27.6      # central through bore
HOLE_DIA   = 6.9       # 8x thru holes
HOLE_X     = 24.5      # hole coordinates
HOLE_Y     = 13.1      #   -> BCD = 2*sqrt(24.5^2+13.1^2) = 55.5
NOTCH_W    = 22.0      # width of the 4 jaw notches
SPLINE_W   = 5.0       # central bore spline slot width
SPLINE_DEP = 2.5       # spline slot depth

R_OUT   = OD / 2
R_NOTCH = NOTCH_DIA / 2
R_BORE  = BORE_DIA / 2

# ---------------- 2D profile ----------------
profile = Circle(R_OUT)

# 4 jaw notches at 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 deg
notch_len = (R_OUT - R_NOTCH) + 2.0          # overlap past OD
notch_cx  = R_NOTCH + notch_len / 2          # floor exactly at R_NOTCH
for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
    profile -= Rot(0, 0, ang) * Pos(notch_cx, 0) * Rectangle(notch_len, NOTCH_W)

# central bore
profile -= Circle(R_BORE)

# spline slots in the bore (one slot at 12 o'clock, 60 deg apart)
spline_len = SPLINE_DEP + 1.0
spline_cx  = R_BORE + (SPLINE_DEP - 1.0) / 2
for i in range(6):
    profile -= Rot(0, 0, 90 + 60 * i) * Pos(spline_cx, 0) * Rectangle(spline_len, SPLINE_W)

# ---------------- solid ----------------
part = extrude(profile, amount=THK)

# 8 bolt holes  ( +-24.5 / +-13.1 and transposed )
hole_pts = []
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        hole_pts.append((sx * HOLE_X, sy * HOLE_Y))
        hole_pts.append((sx * HOLE_Y, sy * HOLE_X))

for (x, y) in hole_pts:
    part -= Pos(x, y, -1) * Cylinder(HOLE_DIA / 2, THK + 2)

export_step(part, "output.step")

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):

                (0, 0),
                (flange_r, 0),
                (flange_r, flange_thk),

                (rod_r, total_height),

from math import radians, cos, sin

# --- dimensions from drawing ---
OD = 80.0                     # outer diameter
ID = 61.3                     # bore diameter (thru)
THK = (OD - ID) / 2.0         # 9.35 radial wall -> axial thickness (square section)
GAP_HALF = 15.0               # half angle of the gap opening (deg, from top)
FILLET_R = 2.7                # 2x R2.7 end corner radii

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # annular ring
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        Circle(radius=OD / 2)
        Circle(radius=ID / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=THK)

    # gap cutter (pie wedge at top)
    a1, a2 = radians(90 - GAP_HALF), radians(90 + GAP_HALF)
    r = OD / 2 + 5
    with BuildSketch() as gs:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((0, 0),
                     (r * cos(a1), r * sin(a1)),
                     (r * cos(a2), r * sin(a2)),
                     close=True)

# ---- printed dimensions ----
width       = 80.0     # overall width
body_h      = 54.7     # plate height (side view)
thickness   = 6.6      # plate thickness
overall_h   = 56.9     # height over ears
bc_dia      = 65.7     # bolt circle dia (4x eq-sp holes)
hole_dia    = 2.4      # all holes
ear_r       = 2.3      # 2x R2.3 (ear end radius)
base_fillet = 1.0      # 4x R1.0 (ear root fillets)
hole_x1     = 34.6     # 2x dia 2.4 THRU, from left edge
hole_x2     = 48.9     # 2x dia 2.4 THRU, from left edge

# ---- derived ----
bc_r = bc_dia / 2.0
off  = bc_r * math.cos(math.radians(45.0))   # 23.228 (45 deg positions)
ear_tip_y = overall_h / 2.0 - ear_r          # 26.15 -> tip reaches 28.45

# ---- base outline with corner ears ----
profile = Rectangle(width, body_h)
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        # ear web
        profile += Pos(sx * off, sy * (18.0 + ear_tip_y) / 2.0) * \
                   Rectangle(2 * ear_r, ear_tip_y - 18.0)
        # ear rounded tip R2.3
        profile += Pos(sx * off, sy * ear_tip_y) * Circle(ear_r)

part = extrude(profile, amount=thickness / 2.0, both=True)

# ---- R1.0 fillets where ears meet the plate edge ----
try:
    junc = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(abs(e.center().Y) - body_h / 2.0) < 1e-6)
    part = fillet(junc, base_fillet)
except Exception:
    pass

# ---- holes ----
# 4x dia 2.4 THRU EQ SP on dia 65.7 BC (in the ear tips)
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        part -= Pos(sx * off, sy * off) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2.0, thickness * 2)

# 2x dia 2.4 THRU (34.6 / 48.9 from left edge, lower row)
for x in (hole_x1, hole_x2):
    part -= Pos(x - width / 2.0, -off) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2.0, thickness * 2)

part = part.clean()
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ----- dimensions (mm) -----
plate_width     = 80.0      # front view width  (corner to corner)
plate_height    = 63.4      # front view height (corner to corner)
edge_radius     = 80.0      # concave edge radius of the star profile
total_depth     = 42.2      # overall depth (side view)
boss_length     = 30.7      # boss protrusion
plate_thickness = total_depth - boss_length   # 11.5
boss_dia        = 30.0      # boss cylinder diameter
hole_dia        = 23.2      # central hole

hw, hh = plate_width / 2, plate_height / 2
corners = [(hw, 0.0), (0.0, hh), (-hw, 0.0), (0.0, -hh)]

def arc_midpoint(p1, p2, r):
    """Mid point of the concave arc (bulging toward origin) from p1 to p2."""
    mx, my = (p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2, (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2
    dx, dy = p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]
    c = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    sag = r - math.sqrt(r * r - (c / 2) ** 2)
    ux, uy = -dy / c, dx / c
    if ux * (-mx) + uy * (-my) < 0:      # make perpendicular point inward
        ux, uy = -ux, -uy
    return (mx + ux * sag, my + uy * sag)

# star profile (four concave arcs)
edges = []
for i in range(4):
    p1 = corners[i]
    p2 = corners[(i + 1) % 4]
    edges.append(ThreePointArc(p1, arc_midpoint(p1, p2, edge_radius), p2))

profile = make_face(edges)

# flat plate (star shape)
plate = extrude(profile, plate_thickness)

# cylindrical boss on the back face
boss = Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness + boss_length / 2) * Cylinder(boss_dia / 2, boss_length)

# through hole
hole = Pos(0, 0, total_depth / 2) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, total_depth + 2)

part = plate + boss - hole

export_step(part, "output.step")

throat_dia     = 21.6     # Ø21.6 through bore
csk_dia        = 36.9     # Ø36.9 countersink mouth
csk_half_angle = 15.5     # 15.5° countersink half angle

cone_start = flange_len          # 8.6  - cone begins at flange back face
nose_start = total_len - end_len # 62.7 - cylindrical nose begins

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---------- outer body (revolved profile) ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0, 0),
                (0, flange_od / 2),
                (cone_start, flange_od / 2),   # flange rim
                (nose_start, end_od / 2),      # outer cone
                (total_len, end_od / 2),       # cylindrical nose
                (total_len, 0),
                close=True,
            )

    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

    # ---------- internal cavity ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):

                (total_len, 0),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

import math
from build123d import *

# ----- dimensions from the drawing -----
total_len   = 80.0      # overall length
flange_od   = 60.5      # flange outer diameter
flange_thk  = 8.6       # flange thickness (Detail A)
small_od    = 30.3      # nose outer diameter
small_len   = 17.3      # nose length (Detail A)
cbore_dia   = 43.2      # front counterbore diameter
cbore_depth = 0.9       # counterbore depth
csk_dia     = 36.9      # countersink diameter
csk_angle   = 15.5      # countersink half angle (deg)
hole_dia    = 21.6      # through bore
corner_r    = 0.4       # R0.4 internal corner

outer_r = flange_od / 2
small_r = small_od / 2
cbore_r = cbore_dia / 2
csk_r   = csk_dia / 2
hole_r  = hole_dia / 2

cone_end_x = total_len - small_len
csk_slope  = math.tan(math.radians(csk_angle))
csk_end_x  = cbore_depth + (csk_r - hole_r) / csk_slope

# Revolve profile in the XZ plane; local (x,y) -> (radial, axial)
profile = Polyline(
    (0.0,     0.0),
    (outer_r, 0.0),
    (outer_r, flange_thk),
    (small_r, cone_end_x),
    (small_r, total_len),
    (hole_r,  total_len),
    (hole_r,  csk_end_x),
    (csk_r,   cbore_depth),
    (cbore_r, cbore_depth),
    (cbore_r, 0.0),
    close=True,
)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            profile
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # R0.4 fillet at the internal corner (counterbore floor meets countersink)
    corner_edges = [
        e for e in bp.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        if abs(e.radius - csk_r) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Z - cbore_depth) < 1e-4
    ]
    if corner_edges:
        fillet(corner_edges, radius=corner_r)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

]

D_BIG    = 35.0        # Ø35 THRU
D_SMALL  = 18.8        # Ø18.8 THRU
T_PLATE  = 18.8        # plate thickness
H_BOSS   = 37.5        # boss / overall height
L_TOTAL  = 80.0        # overall length
C_SMALL  = 65.0        # small-hole center from far end
D_CENTERS = C_SMALL - R_BODY          # 37.5 center-to-center distance

# tangent points between the R27.5 body circle and the R15 end circle
alpha = math.asin((R_BODY - R_END) / D_CENTERS)
ang   = math.pi / 2 + alpha
tx =  R_BODY * math.cos(ang)          # body tangent point x
ty =  R_BODY * math.sin(ang)          # body tangent point y
ex =  R_END  * math.cos(ang)          # end tangent point x
ey =  D_CENTERS + R_END * math.sin(ang)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- flat teardrop plate ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(R_BODY)
        with Locations((0, D_CENTERS)):
            Circle(R_END)
        with BuildLine():
            Line((tx, ty), (-tx, ty))
            Line((-tx, ty), (-ex, ey))
            Line((-ex, ey), (ex, ey))
            Line((ex, ey), (tx, ty))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=T_PLATE)

    # ---- raised half-cylinder boss on the far half of the body ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(R_BODY)
        Rectangle(2 * R_BODY, R_BODY,
                  align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MAX),   # keeps y <= 0 half
                  mode=Mode.INTERSECT)
    extrude(amount=H_BOSS)

    # ---- through holes ----
    with Locations((0, 0)):
        Cylinder(radius=D_BIG / 2, height=2 * H_BOSS, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        Cylinder(radius=D_SMALL / 2, height=2 * H_BOSS, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
overall      = 80.0     # overall width across opposite lobes
lobe_dia     = 32.9     # diameter of each of the 4 lobes
thickness    = 7.1      # plate thickness
waist_fillet = 2.4      # 4x R2.4 concave fillets between lobes
rim_round    = 2.4      # rim round-over (flat side band = 7.1 - 2.4 = 4.7)
n_lobes      = 4

lobe_r = lobe_dia / 2.0                    # 16.45
d      = (overall - lobe_dia) / 2.0        # 23.55  lobe centre distance
s      = lobe_r + waist_fillet
t      = d / math.sqrt(2.0) + math.sqrt(s * s - d * d / 2.0)  # fillet centre radius


def pol(radius, ang_deg):
    a = math.radians(ang_deg)
    return (radius * math.cos(a), radius * math.sin(a))


def lobe_center(j):
    return pol(d, 90.0 * j)


def fillet_center(k):
    return pol(t, 45.0 + 90.0 * k)


def unit(px, py):
    m = math.hypot(px, py)
    return (px / m, py / m)


def tangent_points(k):
    """tangency of concave fillet k with lobe k and lobe k+1"""
    C = fillet_center(k)
    A = lobe_center(k % n_lobes)
    B = lobe_center((k + 1) % n_lobes)
    uA = unit(A[0] - C[0], A[1] - C[1])
    uB = unit(B[0] - C[0], B[1] - C[1])
    TA = (C[0] + waist_fillet * uA[0], C[1] + waist_fillet * uA[1])
    TB = (C[0] + waist_fillet * uB[0], C[1] + waist_fillet * uB[1])
    return TA, TB, C


with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            for k in range(n_lobes):
                TA, TB, C = tangent_points(k)
                # concave R2.4 arc between lobe k and lobe k+1 (bulges toward centre)
                mid_f = (C[0] * (t - waist_fillet) / t,
                         C[1] * (t - waist_fillet) / t)
                ThreePointArc(TA, mid_f, TB)
                # convex arc of lobe k+1 through its outer tip
                j = (k + 1) % n_lobes
                A = lobe_center(j)
                u = unit(A[0], A[1])
                tip = (A[0] + lobe_r * u[0], A[1] + lobe_r * u[1])
                TA_j, _, _ = tangent_points(j)
                ThreePointArc(TB, tip, TA_j)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # round the top and bottom perimeter edges R2.4
    rim_edges = [e for e in bp.edges()
                 if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 or abs(e.center().Z - thickness) < 1e-6]
    fillet(rim_edges, radius=rim_round)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import sqrt, atan2, degrees

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing ----------------
lobe_dia      = 32.9        # Ø32.9 : diameter of each clover lobe
overall_w     = 80.0        # overall width across opposite lobes
neck_r        = 2.4         # 4x R2.4 neck fillets
thick         = 7.1         # total plate thickness
pocket_depth  = 4.7         # 4.7 : depth of the recess
rim           = thick - pocket_depth   # 2.4 rim / floor left over

lobe_R = lobe_dia / 2.0                # 16.45
a      = (overall_w - lobe_dia) / 2.0  # 23.55 -> lobe centre offset

# ---------------- clover profile --------------------------
# 4 lobe arcs (radius lr) joined by 4 tangent neck arcs (radius nr).
# Fillet centre is tangent to both adjacent lobes:
#   dist((u,u),(a,0)) = lr + nr   ->   u = (a - sqrt(2(lr+nr)^2 - a^2)) / 2
def clover_face(lr, nr):
    Rf = lr + nr
    u  = (a - sqrt(2.0 * Rf ** 2 - a ** 2)) / 2.0
    th = degrees(atan2(u, a - u))          # 17.05 deg
    lobe_span   = 360.0 - 2.0 * th         # 325.9 deg
    fillet_span = 90.0 + 2.0 * th          # 124.1 deg

    lobe_c = [(a, 0.0), (0.0, a), (-a, 0.0), (0.0, -a)]   # +X, +Y, -X, -Y
    fil_c  = [(u, u), (-u, u), (-u, -u), (u, -u)]         # between lobe i and i+1

    edges = []
    for i in range(4):
        bx, by = lobe_c[i]
        base = 180.0 + i * 90.0
        s = base + th
        edges.append(Edge.make_circle(lr, Plane(origin=(bx, by, 0)), s, s + lobe_span))
        fx, fy = fil_c[i]
        fs = base - th + 180.0
        edges.append(Edge.make_circle(nr, Plane(origin=(fx, fy, 0)), fs, fs + fillet_span))
    return Face(Wire(edges))

# outer prism profile and inward-offset pocket profile (offset = 2.4 rim)
outer_profile  = clover_face(lobe_R, neck_r)                  # lobes Ø32.9, necks R2.4
pocket_profile = clover_face(lobe_R - rim, neck_r + rim)      # lobes Ø28.1, necks R4.8

# ---------------- solid ----------------------------------
part = extrude(outer_profile, amount=thick, dir=(0, 0, 1))
part -= extrude(Pos(0, 0, rim) * pocket_profile, amount=pocket_depth + 1.0, dir=(0, 0, 1))

export_step(part, "output.step")

chamfer_c    = 0.7           # C0.7 on flange rim

)

boss = Pos(0, 0, cone_length + flange_t + boss_length / 2) * Cylinder(boss_d / 2, boss_length)

def circle_edges(shape, z, r):

import math

# ---- driving dimensions from the drawing ----
width      = 65.0     # across-corners (top edge) of the plan profile
depth      = 80.0     # overall depth of the plan profile
thickness  = 20.0     # plate thickness
across_flat= 56.1     # "56.1 A/F" - between the two top corner facets
fillet_r   = 5.0      # "10x R5"

half_w = width / 2.0
y_top  = depth / 2.0
y_bot  = -depth / 2.0

# chamfer angle so the two corner flats are exactly 56.1 apart
theta = math.asin(across_flat / width)          # ~59.7 deg from horizontal
slant_len = 14.0
Bx =  half_w - slant_len * math.cos(theta)
By =  y_top  - slant_len * math.sin(theta)

# ---- profile key points (right half + mirror) ----
A  = ( half_w, y_top)      # top-right corner of the 65 edge
B  = ( Bx,  By)            # end of the 56.1 A/F chamfer
C  = ( 20.0,  0.0)         # concave waist
D  = ( 21.5, -20.0)        # lower waist
E  = ( 11.0, -37.0)        # start of bottom lobe
F  = (  0.0, y_bot)        # bottom centre

Am = (-half_w, y_top)
Bm = (-Bx,  By)
Cm = (-20.0,  0.0)
Dm = (-21.5, -20.0)
Em = (-11.0, -37.0)

with BuildSketch() as sk:
    with BuildLine():
        Line(Am, A)                                  # 65 top edge
        Line(A, B)                                   # right A/F chamfer
        ThreePointArc(B,  ( 21.0,  13.5), C)         # concave side
        ThreePointArc(C,  ( 19.0, -10.0), D)         # concave side
        ThreePointArc(D,  ( 19.5, -28.5), E)         # convex lower lobe
        ThreePointArc(E,  F, Em)                     # rounded bottom
        ThreePointArc(Em, (-19.5, -28.5), Dm)        # mirrored lobe
        ThreePointArc(Dm, (-19.0, -10.0), Cm)
        ThreePointArc(Cm, (-21.0,  13.5), Bm)
        Line(Bm, Am)                                 # left A/F chamfer
    make_face()

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- printed dimensions ----
thickness   = 24.0     # block thickness (front view)
height      = 80.0     # overall height
depth_total = 42.7     # overall depth (to boss extreme)
hole_cx     = 33.3     # hole centre from back face
hole_dia    = 13.3     # through hole
boss_r      = depth_total - hole_cx   # 9.4  boss radius
xt          = 20.0     # where top edge meets the blend arc
cy          = height / 2.0

# ---- radius of the arc tangent to top edge and to the boss circle ----
# (xt-hole_cx)^2 + (Rc-cy)^2 = (Rc+boss_r)^2
Rc = ((xt - hole_cx) ** 2 + cy ** 2 - boss_r ** 2) / (height + 2 * boss_r)

fc_top = (xt, height - Rc)   # centre of upper blend arc
fc_bot = (xt, Rc)            # centre of lower blend arc
bc     = (hole_cx, cy)       # boss centre

def pt_on(c, r, ang_deg):
    a = math.radians(ang_deg)
    return (c[0] + r * math.cos(a), c[1] + r * math.sin(a))

# tangency direction (boss centre -> upper blend centre)
ang_b = math.degrees(math.atan2(fc_top[1] - cy, fc_top[0] - hole_cx))  # ~120.1
T1 = pt_on(bc, boss_r, ang_b)          # upper tangent point on boss
T2 = pt_on(bc, boss_r, -ang_b)         # lower tangent point on boss

a_top_end   = math.degrees(math.atan2(T1[1] - fc_top[1], T1[0] - fc_top[0]))
a_bot_start = math.degrees(math.atan2(T2[1] - fc_bot[1], T2[0] - fc_bot[0]))

m_top  = pt_on(fc_top, Rc, (90.0 + a_top_end) / 2)
m_bot  = pt_on(fc_bot, Rc, (a_bot_start - 90.0) / 2)
m_boss = pt_on(bc, boss_r, 0.0)        # (42.7, 40)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, 0), (0, height))                 # back face
            Line((0, height), (xt, height))           # top edge
            ThreePointArc((xt, height), m_top, T1)    # upper blend (convex)
            ThreePointArc(T1, m_boss, T2)             # boss wrap-around
            ThreePointArc(T2, m_bot, (xt, 0))         # lower blend
            Line((xt, 0), (0, 0))                     # bottom edge
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)
    with Locations((hole_cx, cy, thickness / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_dia / 2, height=thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
DIA = 31.3                  # cylinder diameter
R = DIA / 2
LENGTH = 80.0               # overall length
AF = 10.4                   # across flats
HAF = AF / 2                # half across flats
FILLET_R = 7.8              # 2x R7.8 transition fillet
FLAT_LEN = 20.0             # planar flat length from the end
STEP_Z = FLAT_LEN + FILLET_R  # end of fillet / step face position

# ---- base cylinder, axis = Z, starting at Z=0 ----
part = Cylinder(R, LENGTH, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- cutting tool: flat + R7.8 blend, built as an XZ profile swept in Y ----
l1 = Line((HAF, 0), (HAF, FLAT_LEN))                              # flat face
arc = CenterArc((HAF + FILLET_R, FLAT_LEN), FILLET_R, 180, -90)   # R7.8 concave blend
l2 = Line(arc @ 1, (40, STEP_Z))                                  # top of step region
l3 = Line((40, STEP_Z), (40, -2))
l4 = Line((40, -2), (HAF, -2))
l5 = Line((HAF, -2), (HAF, 0))
profile = make_face([l1, arc, l2, l3, l4, l5])

cutter = extrude(profile, 20, both=True)   # sweep profile along Z
cutter = Rot(90, 0, 0) * cutter            # reorient sweep along Y (profile -> XZ)

# mill both flats (one per side, symmetric)
part -= cutter
part -= mirror(cutter, Plane.YZ)

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
CYL_DIA    = 31.3   # Ø31.3 cylinder
CYL_LEN    = 80.0   # 80 overall length
SLOT_W     = 10.4   # 10.4 A/F across flats of the tang
FILLET_R   = 7.8    # 2x R7.8 root fillets
SLOT_DEPTH = 20.0   # axial length of the milled tang

# ---------------- Geometry ----------------
# Cylinder: axis along +X, from x = 0 to x = 80
body = Solid.make_cylinder(CYL_DIA / 2, CYL_LEN, plane=Plane.YZ)

# Two cutters removing material where |y| > SLOT_W/2 for x < SLOT_DEPTH.
# The +x face of each cutter must lie exactly at x = SLOT_DEPTH so that
# the step face exists and the root edge (flat <-> step) is well formed.
ext      = 1.0                          # extend past x = 0 for a clean trim
cut_lx   = SLOT_DEPTH + ext
cut_cx   = (SLOT_DEPTH - ext) / 2       # cutter centered so +x face = SLOT_DEPTH
cut_cy   = SLOT_W / 2 + CYL_DIA / 2
cut_sz   = CYL_DIA + 10.0

cut_pos = Pos(cut_cx,  cut_cy, 0) * Box(cut_lx, CYL_DIA, cut_sz)
cut_neg = Pos(cut_cx, -cut_cy, 0) * Box(cut_lx, CYL_DIA, cut_sz)

part = body - cut_pos - cut_neg

# ---------------- 2x R7.8 root fillets ----------------
# Edges parallel to Z, at x = SLOT_DEPTH and y = ±SLOT_W/2
root_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(e.center().X - SLOT_DEPTH) < 1e-3
    and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - SLOT_W / 2) < 1e-3
]
assert len(root_edges) == 2, f"expected 2 root edges, got {len(root_edges)}"

part = fillet(root_edges, FILLET_R)

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- dimensions (mm, from drawing) ----------------
head_dia   = 37.2          # head diameter
shank_dia  = 25.7          # shank diameter
shank_len  = 61.9          # shank length (under head)
total_len  = 80.0          # overall length
head_h     = total_len - shank_len      # 18.1 head height
head_cyl_h = 8.7                        # cylindrical part of pan head
dome_R     = 23.1                       # dome sphere radius
slot_w     = 21.7                       # slot width (cross slot)
slot_depth = 6.0                        # slot depth from head top
slot_bot_z = head_h - slot_depth        # 12.1 slot bottom height

# ---------------- geometry ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # shank (below head)
    Cylinder(radius=shank_dia / 2, height=shank_len,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX))

    # pan head cylindrical portion
    Cylinder(radius=head_dia / 2, height=head_cyl_h,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # domed top of the pan head (revolved profile)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, head_cyl_h), (head_dia / 2, head_cyl_h))
            ThreePointArc((head_dia / 2, head_cyl_h),
                          (11.55, 15.0),          # point on sphere R=23.1
                          (0, head_h))
            Line((0, head_h), (0, head_cyl_h))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # cross slot: two perpendicular slots
    with Locations((0, 0, slot_bot_z)):
        Box(slot_w, 2 * head_dia, total_len,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        Box(2 * head_dia, slot_w, total_len,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

export_step(bp.part, "output.step")

import math

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
shank_dia   = 25.7          # shank Ø25.7
shank_len   = 61.9          # shank length
head_dia    = 37.2          # head Ø37.2
head_r      = head_dia / 2
total_len   = 80.0          # overall length
head_h      = total_len - shank_len          # 18.1 head height

recess_span  = 21.7         # cross recess overall span
recess_w     = 7.5          # recess slot width
recess_depth = 6.0          # recess depth

# dome arc: passes through rim (head_r, shank_len) and apex (0, total_len),
# horizontal tangent at apex
R    = (head_r**2 + head_h**2) / (2 * head_h)
z_c  = total_len - R
a0   = math.atan2(shank_len - z_c, head_r)
am   = (a0 + math.pi / 2) / 2
mid_pt = (R * math.cos(am), z_c + R * math.sin(am))

# ---------------- part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # shank
    Cylinder(shank_dia / 2, shank_len,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # domed head (revolved profile)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((0, shank_len), (head_r, shank_len))
            ThreePointArc((head_r, shank_len), mid_pt, (0, total_len))
            Line((0, total_len), (0, shank_len))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # cross (Phillips style) recess
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(total_len)):
        Rectangle(recess_span, recess_w)
        Rectangle(recess_w, recess_span)
    extrude(amount=-recess_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import tan, radians, sqrt

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing (mm) ----------------
TOTAL_LEN   = 80.0      # overall length
HANDLE_DIA  = 5.5       # 5.5 width at handle end
SHAFT_DIA   = 5.4       # ø5.4 main shaft
WORK_DIA    = 2.7       # ø2.7 working shaft
TIP_DIA     = 3.1       # ø3.1 ball tip
TIP_ANGLE   = 23.3      # included cone angle of tip
GRIP_LEN    = 9.5       # grooved grip section length

r_hand  = HANDLE_DIA / 2
r_shaft = SHAFT_DIA / 2
r_work  = WORK_DIA / 2
r_ball  = TIP_DIA / 2
r_neck  = 0.5

# stations along the axis (X)
x_shaft_end  = 45.0                     # end of main shaft / start of taper
x_taper_end  = 52.5                     # end of taper, start of grip
x_grip_end   = x_taper_end + GRIP_LEN   # end of grooved grip = 62.0
x_neck_start = 70.0                     # start of 23.3 deg neck cone
x_neck_end   = x_neck_start + (r_work - r_neck) / tan(radians(TIP_ANGLE / 2))
ball_cx      = TOTAL_LEN - r_ball       # ball centre x = 78.45
x_ball_start = ball_cx - sqrt(r_ball**2 - r_neck**2)  # neck meets ball exactly

# ---------------- solid of revolution ----------------
handle = Pos(x_shaft_end / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cone(r_hand, r_shaft, x_shaft_end)
taper  = Pos((x_shaft_end + x_taper_end) / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * \
         Cone(r_shaft, r_work, x_taper_end - x_shaft_end)
grip   = Pos((x_taper_end + x_grip_end) / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * \
         Cylinder(r_work, GRIP_LEN)
neck   = Pos((x_grip_end + x_neck_start) / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * \
         Cylinder(r_work, x_neck_start - x_grip_end)
cone   = Pos((x_neck_start + x_neck_end) / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * \
         Cone(r_work, r_neck, x_neck_end - x_neck_start)
neck2  = Pos((x_neck_end + x_ball_start) / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * \
         Cylinder(r_neck, x_ball_start - x_neck_end)
ball   = Pos(ball_cx, 0, 0) * Sphere(r_ball)

part = handle + taper + grip + neck + cone + neck2 + ball

# ---------------- grip grooves ----------------
for i in range(4):
    xg = x_taper_end + GRIP_LEN * (i + 1) / 5
    part -= Pos(xg, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Torus(r_work, 0.4)

# slightly rounded handle end
part = fillet(part.edges().group_by(Axis.X)[0], 0.5)

export_step(part, "output.step")

SHANK_R = SHANK_W / 2.0

Px, Pz = SHANK_R, BEND_Z
dx, dz = -Px, HEAD_CZ - Pz
d  = math.hypot(dx, dz)
L  = math.sqrt(d*d - HEAD_R*HEAD_R)
th = math.atan2(dz, dx)
be = math.asin(HEAD_R / d)
a  = th - be
TX = Px + L * math.cos(a)      # ~4.55
TZ = Pz + L * math.sin(a)      # ~84.18

    extrude(amount=THICKNESS / 2, both=True)

from build123d import *
from math import atan2, degrees, sqrt

# ---------- dimensions ----------
bw        = 4.4 / 2.0      # blade half width
bt        = 1.5 / 2.0      # blade half thickness
boss_t    = 3.3            # eye boss thickness
eye_r     = 9.1 / 2.0      # eye / boss outer radius
eye_hole_r= 5.3 / 2.0      # eye through hole radius
eye_cz    = 75.45          # eye centre height
taper_z   = 44.0           # start of tapered section
top_z     = 80.0           # overall height
bend_z    = 4.5            # start of bent foot
foot_dx   = 6.7            # horizontal reach of the foot
foot_len  = sqrt(bend_z**2 + foot_dx**2)
ang       = degrees(atan2(foot_dx, bend_z))

# ---------- main body ----------
with BuildPart() as main:
    # blade profile (front view)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((-bw, 0.0),
                     ( bw, 0.0),
                     ( bw, taper_z),
                     (0.0, eye_cz),
                     (-bw, taper_z),
                     (-bw, 0.0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bt, both=True)

    # eye boss
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0.0, eye_cz)):
            Circle(eye_r)
    extrude(amount=boss_t / 2.0, both=True)

    # through hole
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0.0, eye_cz)):
            Circle(eye_hole_r)
    extrude(amount=boss_t, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ---------- bent foot ----------
with BuildPart() as footp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(2.0 * bw, 2.0 * bt)
    extrude(amount=-(foot_len + 2.0))

foot = Location((0.0, 0.0, bend_z + 1.0)) * Rotation(ang, 0, 0) * footp.part

part = main.part + foot

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# -----------------------------
# Dimension variables (from drawing)
# -----------------------------
overall_height = 80.0          # total height
overall_width  = 28.2          # width X
overall_depth  = 18.8          # thickness/depth Y

top_radius      = 14.1         # R14.1 top outer radius
top_hole_dia    = 15.7         # Ø15.7 top pin hole
top_hole_center_z = overall_height - top_radius  # 65.9

slot_top_width  = 6.3          # side-view clevis slot width (Y)
slot_top_bottom_z = top_hole_center_z            # 65.9 slot bottom height

bottom_hole_dia = 12.5         # Ø12.5 through hole at bottom
bottom_hole_center_z = 12.5    # height of bottom hole centre
bottom_radius   = 12.5         # R12.5 (bottom side radius)

slot_bottom_width = 14.1       # front-view lower slot width (X)
slot_bottom_height = 25.1      # front-view lower slot depth from bottom

# -----------------------------
# Build the part
# -----------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Main profile in XZ plane:
    #    rectangle from Z=0 to Z=65.9, with a semicircular top
    #    of radius 14.1 centred at Z=65.9.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with Locations((0, 0)):
            Rectangle(overall_width, top_hole_center_z,
                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        with Locations((0, top_hole_center_z)):
            Circle(top_radius)
        # The union of rectangle and circle is the external profile.
        # build123d sketch union is automatic in BuildSketch if not Mode.PRIVATE
    extrude(amount=overall_depth / 2, both=True)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Subtract the top clevis slot (side view U-slot)
    #    open at the top, width 6.3 in Y, from Z=65.9 to Z=80.
    #    The slot is cut through the entire X width.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with Locations((0, (overall_height + slot_top_bottom_z) / 2)):
            Rectangle(slot_top_width,
                      overall_height - slot_top_bottom_z,
                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    extrude(amount=overall_width, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Subtract the bottom slot visible in the front view
    #    width 14.1 in X, depth 25.1 from the bottom, through Y.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with Locations((0, slot_bottom_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(slot_bottom_width,
                      slot_bottom_height,
                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    extrude(amount=overall_depth, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Subtract the top pin hole Ø15.7, axis along Y
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with Locations((0, top_hole_center_z)):
            Circle(top_hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=overall_depth, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Subtract the bottom cross hole Ø12.5 through, axis along X
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with Locations((0, bottom_hole_center_z)):
            Circle(bottom_hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=overall_width, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Optional: round the bottom side edges with R12.5
    #    (the two bottom outer edges parallel to X)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Select the bottom edges that lie along the X direction
    bottom_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6
    )
    if bottom_edges:
        fillet(bottom_edges, radius=bottom_radius)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
across_flats = 69.3                 # width across flats
thickness    = 35.7                 # nut height
hole_dia     = 44.5                 # thru hole
face_dia     = 56.0                 # flat circle left on the ends by the nut chamfer
chamfer_slope = math.tan(math.radians(30.0))   # chamfer cone 30deg off end face (120deg incl.)

# ---------------- hexagon profile (flats left/right, corners top/bottom) ----------------
R = (across_flats / 2) / math.cos(math.radians(30.0))     # circumradius = 40.01 (across corners 80)
pts = [
    (R * math.cos(math.radians(30.0 + 60.0 * i)),
     R * math.sin(math.radians(30.0 + 60.0 * i)))
    for i in range(6)
]

# ---------------- hex body with through hole ----------------
body = extrude(Polygon(*pts, align=None), amount=thickness)
body -= Cylinder(radius=hole_dia / 2, height=thickness * 4)

# ---------------- 120deg nut chamfer on both ends ----------------
rc     = face_dia / 2
apex_z = thickness + rc * chamfer_slope     # apex of the cutting cone
base_r = apex_z / chamfer_slope             # cone radius at z = 0

cutter = Box(base_r * 4, base_r * 4, apex_z + 5,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)) \
         - Cone(base_r, 0, apex_z,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

body -= cutter
body -= mirror(cutter, about=Plane.XY)

part = body
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----------------
DIA       = 75.3            # outer diameter of the cylinder
R         = DIA / 2.0       # = 37.65
LEN       = 54.7            # axial length of the cylinder
AF        = 36.5            # across flats (top / bottom flats)
FLAT_BOT  = 19.2            # bottom flat height above the lowest point
FLAT_TOP  = FLAT_BOT + AF   # = 55.7  top flat height above the lowest point
WIDTH     = 80.0            # overall width across the tabs
TAB_Y     = 11.4            # tab width measured along the axis
TAB_H     = 6.9             # tab protrusion height above the flat

# Model centred on the cylinder axis: axis along Y, Z vertical
z_bot = FLAT_BOT - R        # -18.45
z_top = FLAT_TOP - R        # +18.05

# ---------------- 1. main cylinder ----------------
part = Cylinder(R, LEN, rotation=(90, 0, 0))

# ---------------- 2. top and bottom flats (36.5 A/F) --------
part -= Pos(0, 0, z_top + 60) * Box(220, 220, 120)   # top flat  at +18.05
part -= Pos(0, 0, z_bot - 60) * Box(220, 220, 120)   # bottom flat at -18.45

# ---------------- 3. corner tabs (4 off), 80 wide overall ---
for ys in (1, -1):
    y_end = ys * LEN / 2.0                 # flush with the cylinder end face
    y_in  = y_end - ys * TAB_Y             # tab is 11.4 wide
    for zs in (1, -1):
        z_flat = z_top if zs > 0 else z_bot
        z_top_tab = zs * R                 # tab rises to the cylinder top deck
        tab = Box(WIDTH, TAB_Y, abs(z_top_tab - z_flat))
        tab = Pos(0, (y_end + y_in) / 2.0,
                     (z_flat + z_top_tab) / 2.0) * tab
        part += tab

part = part.clean()
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- Build ----------------

    # main cylinder
    Cylinder(body_r, body_len, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # reduced diameter end section

        Location((-tab_x_center, tab_y_center, tab_z_center)),
    ):
        Box(tab_out_x - step_r, tab_width, tab_len)

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
outer_dia = 75.3          # ø75.3 main cylinder
body_len  = 54.7          # cylinder length (side view: 54.7)
overall_w = 80.0          # overall width across the lugs (top view: 80)
lug_flat  = 36.5          # lug width across flats (front view: 36.5 A/F)
lug_len   = 6.9           # axial length of each lug (6.9 HIGH)

lug_protrusion = (overall_w - outer_dia) / 2.0   # radial stick-out = 2.35

# ---------------- Main cylinder ----------------
# Axis along Z, base at Z = 0
body = Cylinder(
    radius=outer_dia / 2,
    height=body_len,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

# ---------------- Lug blocks ----------------
# One lug on the +X side at the near end, one on the -X side at the far end
def lug_block(z_start: float):
    """Rectangular lug, extruded radially out from the axis to X = overall_w/2."""
    b = Box(
        outer_dia / 2 + lug_protrusion,   # radial extent (reaches into the cylinder)
        lug_flat,                         # tangential width (36.5)
        lug_len,                          # axial length (6.9)
        align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
    )
    return Pos(0, 0, z_start) * b

lug_near = lug_block(0.0)                               # +X side, Z = 0 .. 6.9
lug_far  = Rot(0, 0, 180) * lug_block(body_len - lug_len)  # -X side, far end

# ---------------- Combine ----------------
part = body + lug_near + lug_far

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
AF = 80.0                  # octagon across flats (square 80 x 80 before corner chamfers)
CORNER_CHAMFER = 13.3      # 4x C13.3 corner chamfers
THICKNESS = 10.7           # part thickness
CBORE_DIA = 66.7           # counterbore diameter
CBORE_DEPTH = 7.3          # counterbore depth from front face
FILLET_R = 2.7             # R2.7 fillet at counterbore bottom
STEP = 2.7                 # radial step of annular face (66.7 -> 61.3)
BORE_DIA = CBORE_DIA - 2 * STEP   # through bore = 61.3

# ---------------- Build ----------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Octagonal plate: square 80x80 with 4 corner chamfers C13.3
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        Rectangle(AF, AF)
        chamfer(sk.vertices(), length=CORNER_CHAMFER)
    extrude(amount=THICKNESS)

    # Counterbore Ø66.7 x 7.3 deep from the front (top) face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(THICKNESS)):
        Circle(CBORE_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=-CBORE_DEPTH, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Through bore Ø61.3
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(BORE_DIA / 2)
    extrude(amount=THICKNESS, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # R2.7 fillet on the internal corner at the bottom of the counterbore.
    # Use a slightly smaller radius than the exact radial step so that OCC
    # has a valid sliver of annular face to blend into.
    z_corner = THICKNESS - CBORE_DEPTH
    corner_edges = p.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.radius - BORE_DIA / 2) < 1e-6
        and abs(e.center().Z - z_corner) < 1e-6
    )
    fillet(corner_edges, radius=FILLET_R - 0.01)

export_step(part, "output.step")

cc = corner_cham

    # ---- Octagonal plate ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Polygon(
            (-h + cc,  h), ( h - cc,  h),
            ( h,  h - cc), ( h, -h + cc),
            ( h - cc, -h), (-h + cc, -h),
            (-h, -h + cc), (-h,  h - cc),
            align=None,
        )
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # ---- Revolve the inner cut: through hole + counterbore + R2.7 fillet ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():

            Polyline(

                (hole_dia / 2, 0),

from build123d import *
from math import atan2, degrees

# ---------------- given dimensions ----------------
width    = 48.0     # profile width
depth    = 18.7     # profile overall height (part depth)
length   = 86.0     # extrusion length
r_corner = 6.7      # 2x R6.7 corner fillets
side_h   = 4.0      # short vertical side before the fillet

# ---------------- derived profile geometry ----------------
# central hump arc is tangent to both corner fillet arcs (smooth blend)
a = width / 2.0 - r_corner                  # 17.3
b = depth - side_h                          # 14.7
R  = (a * a + b * b - r_corner * r_corner) / (2.0 * (b - r_corner))  # hump radius
yc = depth - R                              # hump centre height

# tangent point of fillet and hump (left side)
cos_phi = a / (r_corner - R)
sin_phi = (yc - side_h) / (r_corner - R)
phi = degrees(atan2(sin_phi, cos_phi))      # ~139.6 deg on the fillet circle

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, 0), (width, 0))                                  # flat bottom
            Line((width, 0), (width, side_h))                         # right side
            CenterArc((width - r_corner, side_h), r_corner,
                      0, 180 - phi)                                   # right R6.7
            CenterArc((width / 2, yc), R,
                      180 - phi, 2 * phi - 180)                       # central hump
            CenterArc((r_corner, side_h), r_corner,
                      phi, 180 - phi)                                 # left R6.7
            Line((0, side_h), (0, 0))                                 # left side
        make_face()

BASE_LEN   = 80.0          # overall length of base plate
BASE_R     = 13.3          # 2x R13.3 end radius
BASE_WID   = 2 * BASE_R    # 26.6
BASE_THK   = 13.3          # base plate thickness
END_HOLE_D = 8.3           # 2 x Ø8.3 thru
END_HOLE_X = 40.0 - BASE_R # 13.3 from each end
CTR_HOLE_D = 16.7          # Ø16.7 thru (centre)

BOSS_W     = 44.2          # lower boss width
BOSS_THK   = 18.3          # lower boss thickness (Y)
BOSS_TOP   = 53.3          # height of boss step

TAB_W      = 35.8          # upper tab width
TAB_THK    = 16.7          # upper tab thickness (Y)
TAB_CZ     = 65.8          # height of Ø25 hole centre
BIG_HOLE_D = 25.0          # Ø25 thru

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- obround base plate ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        SlotOverall(BASE_LEN, BASE_WID)
    extrude(amount=BASE_THK)

    # ---- lower boss (44.2 wide) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0, (BASE_THK + BOSS_TOP) / 2)):
            Rectangle(BOSS_W, BOSS_TOP - BASE_THK)
    extrude(amount=BOSS_THK / 2, both=True)

    # ---- upper tab with rounded top (Ø35.8) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0, (BOSS_TOP + TAB_CZ) / 2)):
            Rectangle(TAB_W, TAB_CZ - BOSS_TOP)
        with Locations((0, TAB_CZ)):
            Circle(TAB_W / 2)
    extrude(amount=TAB_THK / 2, both=True)

    # ---- centre hole Ø16.7 thru base ----
    with Locations(Location((0, 0, BASE_THK / 2))):
        Cylinder(CTR_HOLE_D / 2, BASE_THK * 3, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 2 x Ø8.3 thru base ----
    with Locations(Location((END_HOLE_X, 0, BASE_THK / 2)),
                   Location((-END_HOLE_X, 0, BASE_THK / 2))):
        Cylinder(END_HOLE_D / 2, BASE_THK * 3, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Ø25 thru hole in tab ----
    with Locations(Location((0, 0, TAB_CZ))):
        Cylinder(BIG_HOLE_D / 2, TAB_THK * 4, rotation=(90, 0, 0),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

def half_capsule(radius, total_length):
    """Create a half-capsule (capsule cut at Z=0, keeping Z>=0) along the X axis."""
    cyl_len = total_length - 2 * radius
    # Cylinder along Z, then rotate to X
    cyl = Cylinder(radius, cyl_len, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    cyl = Rot(0, 90, 0) * cyl
    # Hemispherical ends
    sphere1 = Pos(cyl_len / 2, 0, 0) * Sphere(radius)
    sphere2 = Pos(-cyl_len / 2, 0, 0) * Sphere(radius)
    capsule = cyl + sphere1 + sphere2
    # Cut with plane Z=0, keep the upper half
    half = split(capsule, Plane.XY, keep=Keep.TOP)
    return half


# Three half-capsules: middle and two outer
middle = half_capsule(R_middle, length)
left = Pos(0, -d, 0) * half_capsule(R_outer, length)
right = Pos(0, d, 0) * half_capsule(R_outer, length)

# Union to form the final part
part = middle + left + right

export_step(part, "output.step")

from math import atan2, degrees

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W      = 34.4      # width of the part (extrusion depth)
t      = 7.6       # wall thickness of the hook
H      = 80.0      # overall height
L      = 66.2      # overall length (to the tail tip)
AF     = 107.9     # "A/F" across the top bend -> outer width of the U
tip_y  = 8.5       # height of the tail tip above the bottom of the leg
bend_y = 30.0      # height where the right leg turns into the tail

outer_w = AF / 2.0            # 53.95  outer width across the U bend
R_out   = outer_w / 2.0       # outer radius of the top bend
R_in    = R_out - t           # inner radius of the top bend

# tail bend: outer arc tangent to the right leg outer face, passing through tip
dx = L - outer_w              # 12.25
dy = bend_y - tip_y           # 21.5
R_t = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / (2.0 * dx)
cx, cy = outer_w + R_t, bend_y

end_ang = degrees(atan2(tip_y - cy, L - cx))
if end_ang < 180.0:
    end_ang += 360.0
sweep = end_ang - 180.0

# inner tip corner (radial cut through the tail thickness)
import math
ux, uy = (L - cx) / R_t, (tip_y - cy) / R_t
tip_inner = (cx + ux * (R_t + t), cy + uy * (R_t + t))

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            # outer boundary
            Line((0, 0), (0, H - R_out))
            ThreePointArc((0, H - R_out), (R_out, H), (outer_w, H - R_out))
            Line((outer_w, H - R_out), (outer_w, bend_y))
            CenterArc((cx, cy), R_t, 180.0, sweep)
            # tail end face
            Line((L, tip_y), tip_inner)
            # inner boundary
            CenterArc((cx, cy), R_t + t, end_ang, -sweep)
            Line((outer_w - t, bend_y), (outer_w - t, H - R_out))
            ThreePointArc((outer_w - t, H - R_out),
                          (R_out, H - R_out + R_in),
                          (t, H - R_out))
            Line((t, H - R_out), (t, 0))
            Line((t, 0), (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=W / 2.0, both=True)

from build123d import *
from math import radians, cos, sin, atan2, degrees

# ---------------- dimensions from the drawing ----------------
width    = 34.4     # bar width (Y direction)
t        = 7.6      # bar thickness
H        = 80.0     # overall height (bottom of legs to top of the U bend)
L        = 66.2     # overall horizontal extent (left leg face to tail tip)
tip_drop = 8.5      # tail tip drops this far below the bottom of the legs

# ---------------- geometry of the U bend ----------------
U_out = 40.0                    # outside width of the U (from view proportions)
R_out = U_out / 2.0             # outer radius of the top bend
zc    = H - R_out               # height where the straight legs meet the bend
z1    = 45.0                    # height where the tail bend starts on the right leg

# tail: upper (concave) face radius r_c, centre at (U_out + r_c, z1)
# the lower (convex) face has radius r_c + t and passes through the tip (L, -tip_drop)
dx = L - U_out
Dz = tip_drop + z1
r_c = (dx * dx + Dz * Dz - t * t) / (2.0 * (dx + t))
cx, cz = U_out + r_c, z1

tip = (L, -tip_drop)
ux, uz = (cx - L) / (r_c + t), (cz + tip_drop) / (r_c + t)
inner_tip = (L + t * ux, -tip_drop + t * uz)

a0 = 180.0
a1 = degrees(atan2(inner_tip[1] - cz, inner_tip[0] - cx)) % 360.0
am = (a0 + a1) / 2.0
mid_conc = (cx + r_c * cos(radians(am)),        cz + r_c * sin(radians(am)))
mid_conv = (cx + (r_c + t) * cos(radians(am)),  cz + (r_c + t) * sin(radians(am)))

# ---------------- build the part ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, 0), (0, zc))                                        # left leg, outer face
            ThreePointArc((0, zc), (R_out, H), (U_out, zc))              # outer bend
            Line((U_out, zc), (U_out, z1))                               # right leg, outer face
            ThreePointArc((U_out, z1), mid_conc, inner_tip)              # tail upper face
            Line(inner_tip, tip)                                         # tail end face
            ThreePointArc(tip, mid_conv, (U_out - t, z1))                # tail lower face
            Line((U_out - t, z1), (U_out - t, zc))                       # right leg, inner face
            ThreePointArc((U_out - t, zc), (U_out / 2, H - t), (t, zc))  # inner bend
            Line((t, zc), (t, 0))                                        # left leg, inner face
            Line((t, 0), (0, 0))                                         # left leg end face
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=width / 2, both=True)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

inner_dia = 77.8      # Ø77.8 inner diameter of spiral

strip_t = (outer_dia - inner_dia) / (2 * n_turns)

# spiral centreline limits
r_i = inner_dia / 2 + strip_t / 2
r_o = outer_dia / 2 - strip_t / 2
k   = (r_o - r_i) / (n_turns * 2 * math.pi)      # Archimedean growth

# ---- build the spiral band as a closed 2-D profile ----
N = 1200
out_pts, in_pts = [], []
for i in range(N + 1):
    th = n_turns * 2 * math.pi * i / N
    r = r_i + k * th
    c, s = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
    px, py = r * c, r * s
    # tangent of the spiral
    tx, ty = k * c - r * s, k * s + r * c
    L = math.hypot(tx, ty)
    tx, ty = tx / L, ty / L
    nx, ny = -ty, tx                     # normal
    if nx * c + ny * s > 0:              # force normal to point inward
        nx, ny = -nx, -ny
    out_pts.append((px - nx * strip_t / 2, py - ny * strip_t / 2))
    in_pts.append((px + nx * strip_t / 2, py + ny * strip_t / 2))

spiral = Polygon(*out_pts, *in_pts[::-1], align=None)

arm = Pos(r_i / 2, 0) * Rectangle(r_i, 2.0)

profile = spiral + boss + arm

# ---- give the part its 2.2 mm thickness ----
part = extrude(profile, amount=strip_w)

export_step(part, "output.step")

            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
        )

    # Small hole through the left end wall
    Cylinder(
        radius=hole_dia / 2,
        height=wall_t,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
        mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
    )

export_step(part, "output.step")

ang_L    = 160.3    # arc angle of left end

thL = radians(ang_L / 2.0)   # 80.15 deg

RR = fillet_r + (hw - fillet_r) / sin(thR)
RL = fillet_r + (hw - fillet_r) / sin(thL)

TRb = (TRt[0], -TRt[1])

PLt = (RL * cos(thL),  RL * sin(thL))            # left arc, top end

from build123d import *

# ---------------- nominal dimensions ----------------
outer_w = 80.0          # X, overall width  (front view)
outer_h = 80.0          # Z, overall height (front view)
outer_d = 32.0          # Y, overall depth  (side / top view)
wall    = 4.0           # (80 - 72) / 2 wall stock
round_r = 6.0           # 8 x R6 outer rounds

cavity_w = 72.0         # opening width
cavity_h = 72.0         # opening height
cavity_d = outer_d - wall     # 28  -> 4 mm back wall
cavity_r = round_r - wall     # 2   -> concentric inner corner radius

# ---------------- outer shell ----------------
outer = Box(outer_w, outer_d, outer_h)

# four edges running along the depth direction -> R6 (rounded corners in front view)
outer = fillet(outer.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), radius=round_r)

# perimeter edges of the back face -> R6 (rounded back contour in side/top view)
back_edges = outer.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1].edges()
outer = fillet(back_edges, radius=round_r)

# ---------------- inner cavity (open at the front) ----------------
cavity = Box(cavity_w, cavity_d, cavity_h)
cavity = fillet(cavity.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), radius=cavity_r)
# place it so its front face is flush with the front of the box, 4 mm back wall remains
cavity = Pos(0, -outer_d / 2 + cavity_d / 2, 0) * cavity

part = outer - cavity

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing ----------------
length   = 80.0    # overall length          (top view "80")
depth    = 25.0    # overall depth           (side view "25")
height   = 35.0    # overall height          ("35")
top_t    = 7.5     # top bar thickness       ("7.5")
leg_h    = 27.5    # leg height below bar    ("27.5")
leg_w    = 10.0    # leg width               ("10")
r_left   = 3.8     # left end radius         ("R3.8")
r_right  = 5.0     # right corner radius     ("R5")
r_inner  = 3.0     # leg/bar fillet          ("2x R3")
cham     = 1.5     # chamfer                 ("18x C1.5")

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- front profile (extruded 25 deep) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, 0.0),                     # bottom-left of left leg
                (leg_w, 0.0),                   # bottom-right of left leg
                (leg_w, leg_h),                 # up inner face of left leg
                (length - leg_w, leg_h),        # underside of top bar
                (length - leg_w, 0.0),          # down inner face of right leg
                (length, 0.0),                  # bottom-right of right leg
                (length, height),               # up right outer face
                (0.0, height),                  # top edge
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

        # inner fillets (2x R3) at the leg / top bar junctions
        fillet(
            sk.vertices().filter_by(
                lambda v: abs(v.X - leg_w) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - leg_h) < 1e-6
            ),
            radius=r_inner,
        )
        fillet(
            sk.vertices().filter_by(
                lambda v: abs(v.X - (length - leg_w)) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - leg_h) < 1e-6
            ),
            radius=r_inner,
        )
        # outer corner radii
        fillet(
            sk.vertices().filter_by(
                lambda v: abs(v.X) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - height) < 1e-6
            ),
            radius=r_left,
        )
        fillet(
            sk.vertices().filter_by(
                lambda v: abs(v.X - length) < 1e-6 and abs(v.Y - height) < 1e-6
            ),
            radius=r_right,
        )

    extrude(amount=depth)

    # ---- C1.5 chamfers on the edges of the two profile faces ----
    fb_edges = []
    for f in bp.faces():
        n = f.normal_at()
        if abs(abs(n.Z) - 1.0) < 1e-6:          # front / back faces
            fb_edges.extend(f.edges())
    chamfer(fb_edges, length=cham)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

shank_dia      = 7.7     # shank diameter

slot_width     = 3.1     # slot width

tip_to_slot    = 76.9    # tip to slot bottom (gives 80.0 overall length)

total_len = tip_to_slot + slot_depth          # 80.0
shank_len = total_len - cone_len              # 72.3

# ---------------- shank ----------------
shank = Cylinder(
    radius=shank_dia / 2,
    height=shank_len,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

    top_radius=head_dia / 2,
    height=cone_len,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

part = shank + head

# ---------------- slot ----------------

    length=head_dia + 2,
    width=slot_width,
    height=2 * slot_depth,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX),
)
part = part - slot

export_step(part, "output.step")

shank_d = 7.7          # shank diameter
shank_len = 76.9       # shank length (to underside of head)
head_d = 17.9          # head diameter
head_h = 3.1           # head axial height
slot_w = 3.1           # slot width (from 3.1 callout)
slot_depth = 1.5       # slot depth (not explicitly dimensioned, less than head_h)
slot_len = head_d + 1.0  # slightly longer than head diameter for clean cut

# ---- build shank ----
# cylinder along X axis from x=0 to x=shank_len
shank = (
    Pos(0, 0, 0)
    * Rot(0, 90, 0)
    * Cylinder(
        radius=shank_d / 2,
        height=shank_len,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
    )
)

# ---- build countersunk head ----
# cone from shank diameter to head diameter, along X axis
head = (
    Pos(shank_len, 0, 0)
    * Rot(0, 90, 0)
    * Cone(
        bottom_radius=shank_d / 2,
        top_radius=head_d / 2,
        height=head_h,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
    )
)

part = shank + head

# ---- cut screwdriver slot into head ----
head_top = shank_len + head_h

# Box aligns its local X with global X (slot depth), local Y with global Y (slot width),
# local Z with global Z (slot length across head).
slot_cutter = (
    Pos(head_top, 0, 0)
    * Box(
        length=slot_depth,
        width=slot_w,
        height=slot_len,
        align=(Align.MAX, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
    )
)

part = part - slot_cutter

# ---- export ----
export_step(part, "output.step")

                (hook_y,  tip_z),       # front face of hook tip

                (hook_y - tip_w, arm_z),# inner face of tip going up
                (hw,      arm_z),       # underside of arm back to column
                (hw,      leg_h),       # down front face of column

                (0.0, 74.8),            # left face
                (13.4, H),              # 13.4 x 21.3° top-left chamfer
                (COL_D, H),             # flat top

                (0.0, FOOT_H),

    (22, 78),
    (18, 80),
    (0, 80),
    (0, 0),
]

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # Main extruded profile
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=W / 2, both=True)

from build123d import *

# Named dimensions from the drawing
W = 28.1                 # main block width (X)
D_MAIN = 28.1            # main block depth (Y)
D_TOTAL = 43.9           # total part depth (Y)
H_TOTAL = 80.0           # overall height (Z)
H_PIN = 13.8             # bottom pin height
D_PIN = 14.0             # bottom pin diameter
Z_LOWER_1 = 38.2         # lower arm bottom
Z_LOWER_2 = 64.0         # lower arm top / slot bottom
Z_UPPER_1 = 76.3         # upper arm bottom / slot top
Z_UPPER_2 = 80.0         # top of part
R_INNER = 5.4            # inner fillet radius

# Build the main solid
main = Pos(0, D_MAIN / 2, H_PIN + (H_TOTAL - H_PIN) / 2) * Box(W, D_MAIN, H_TOTAL - H_PIN)

lower_arm = Pos(0, (D_MAIN + D_TOTAL) / 2,
                (Z_LOWER_1 + Z_LOWER_2) / 2) * Box(W, D_TOTAL - D_MAIN, Z_LOWER_2 - Z_LOWER_1)

upper_arm = Pos(0, (D_MAIN + D_TOTAL) / 2,
                (Z_UPPER_1 + Z_UPPER_2) / 2) * Box(W, D_TOTAL - D_MAIN, Z_UPPER_2 - Z_UPPER_1)

pin = Pos(0, D_MAIN / 2, H_PIN / 2) * Cylinder(D_PIN / 2, H_PIN)

part = main + lower_arm + upper_arm + pin

# Fillet the two inside corners of the hook slot
fillet_edges = []
for z_val in [Z_LOWER_2, Z_UPPER_1]:
    edges = part.edges().filter_by(
        lambda e, z=z_val: abs(e.center().Y - D_MAIN) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Z - z) < 1e-4
    )
    fillet_edges.extend(edges)

if fillet_edges:
    part = fillet(fillet_edges, R_INNER)

# Chamfer on the upper arm top-right end (13.4 x 21.3°)
top_right = part.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Y - D_TOTAL) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Z - Z_UPPER_2) < 1e-4
)
if top_right:
    try:
        part = chamfer(top_right, length=13.4, angle=21.3)
    except Exception:
        pass

# Top-view chamfers on the main block (2x 4.3 x 39.3° and 2x 5.6 x 32.3°)
top_front = part.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - H_TOTAL) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Y - 0) < 1e-4
)
top_back = part.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z - H_TOTAL) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Y - D_MAIN) < 1e-4
)
if top_front:
    try:
        part = chamfer(top_front, length=4.3, angle=39.3)
    except Exception:
        pass
if top_back:
    try:
        part = chamfer(top_back, length=5.6, angle=32.3)
    except Exception:
        pass

# Front-view top corner chamfers 2x C3.5
for sx in [-1, 1]:
    edge = part.edges().filter_by(
        lambda e, sx=sx: abs(e.center().X - sx * W / 2) < 1e-4 and abs(e.center().Z - H_TOTAL) < 1e-4
    )
    if edge:
        try:
            part = chamfer(edge, length=3.5)
        except Exception:
            pass

step_od     = 75.2      # diameter of top face after edge chamfer/step
cbore_dia   = 4.0       # counterbore diameter
cbore_dep   = 1.2       # counterbore depth
ctr_hole    = 2.4       # centre hole diameter (THRU)
side_hole   = 5.6       # small hole diameter (THRU)
side_hole_y = 36.8      # radial position of small hole (mid-rim)
fil_r       = 1.8       # corner fillet radius (6x R1.8)
slot_rin    = 14.0      # slot inner radius
slot_rout   = rim_id / 2.0
slot_span   = 96.0      # angular span of each slot
n_slots     = 3
cham        = (disc_od - step_od) / 2.0  # 2.4

# ---- base disc with top outer chamfer ----
disc = Cylinder(disc_od / 2, disc_th,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
top_edges = disc.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
disc = chamfer(top_edges, cham)

# ---- raised central boss ----
boss = Pos(0, 0, disc_th) * Cylinder(
    boss_od / 2, boss_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = disc + boss

# ---- three lobed / petal shaped through slots ----
a = slot_span / 2.0
e1 = CenterArc((0, 0), slot_rout, -a, 2 * a)
e2 = Line(e1 @ 1, (slot_rin * cos(radians(a)), slot_rin * sin(radians(a))))
e3 = CenterArc((0, 0), slot_rin, a, -2 * a)
e4 = Line(e3 @ 1, e1 @ 0)
slot_face = Face(Wire([e1, e2, e3, e4]))
slot = extrude(Pos(0, 0, -1) * slot_face, amount=total_h + 2)
slot = fillet(slot.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fil_r)

for i in range(n_slots):
    part -= Rot(0, 0, i * 360.0 / n_slots) * slot

# ---- centre hole (through) ----
part -= Pos(0, 0, -1) * Cylinder(
    ctr_hole / 2, total_h + 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- counterbore into the boss top ----

part -= Pos(0, side_hole_y, -1) * Cylinder(
    side_hole / 2, total_h + 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

A = OUT_LEN / 2.0
B = OUT_WID / 2.0
S_RO = SLOT_OD / 2.0
S_RI = HUB_D / 2.0


def annular_sector(r_i, r_o, a0, a1):
    """Planar annular sector between radii r_i..r_o, angles a0..a1 (deg)."""
    outer = CenterArc((0, 0), r_o, a0, a1 - a0)
    inner = CenterArc((0, 0), r_i, a1, a0 - a1)
    e1 = Line(outer @ 1, inner @ 0)
    e2 = Line(inner @ 1, outer @ 0)
    return make_face([outer, e1, inner, e2])


# one through-slot, centred opposite the spoke at 90 deg

slot = fillet(slot.vertices(), R_FIL)          # R1.8 corners

# plate outline with the three slots removed

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- printed dimensions ----------------
ACROSS_FLATS = 70.9      # HEX 70.9 A/F
THICKNESS    = 30.7      # 30.7
CHAMFER_ANGLE = 30.0     # standard hex-nut end chamfer (deg measured from end face)

apothem  = ACROSS_FLATS / 2.0
circum_r = apothem / math.cos(math.radians(30.0))   # across-corners radius
slope    = math.tan(math.radians(CHAMFER_ANGLE))

# ---------------- hex prism ----------------
hex_sk = RegularPolygon(circum_r, 6, major_radius=True)
part = extrude(hex_sk, THICKNESS)

# ---------------- 30 deg chamfers on both ends ----------------
# Material is kept inside a 30 deg cone; the cones are tangent to the flats at
# the end faces, so only the corners are broken, giving the classic nut form.
cone_top = Cone(apothem + THICKNESS * slope, apothem, THICKNESS,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
cone_bot = Cone(apothem, apothem + THICKNESS * slope, THICKNESS,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

part = part & cone_top & cone_bot

export_step(part, "output.step")
