flange_depth  = 33.7    # overall horizontal depth (back face to flange tip)
hole_dia      = 11.4    # Ø 11.4 THRU
hole_z        = 40.0    # hole centre height (40 below the top)
bend_radius   = 6.7     # R6.7 inner bend radius
top_radius    = width / 2.0          # 13.5 -> fully rounded top

bend_z  = flange_drop                # 29.4  (bend line height)
arc_cz  = total_height - top_radius  # 66.5  (centre of the top arc)

# flange direction (from front face of plate down/forward to the tip)
dx, dz = flange_depth - thickness, -flange_drop
L = math.hypot(dx, dz)
ux, uz = dx / L, dz / L
px, pz = -uz, ux                     # normal to the flange (up/forward)

tip_out = (flange_depth, 0.0)                          # bottom / outer tip
tip_in  = (tip_out[0] + px * thickness,
           tip_out[1] + pz * thickness)                # upper / inner tip

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- side profile, extruded across the width ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((0, bend_z), (0, arc_cz))                                  # back face
            ThreePointArc((0, arc_cz), (top_radius, total_height),
                          (thickness, arc_cz))                              # rounded top
            Line((thickness, arc_cz), (thickness, bend_z))                  # front face
            Line((thickness, bend_z), tip_in)                               # flange inner
            Line(tip_in, tip_out)                                           # flange end
            Line(tip_out, (0, bend_z))                                      # flange outer
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=width / 2, both=True)

    inner = bp.edges().filter_by(

    if inner:

    # ---- Ø11.4 through hole (normal to the plate) ----
    with Locations((thickness / 2, 0, hole_z)):
        Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, thickness + 6.0, rotation=(0, 90, 0),

# Derived values for angled flange
len_flange = math.sqrt((L - T)**2 + V**2)
offset_x = T * V / len_flange
offset_y = T * (L - T) / len_flange

with BuildPart() as part:
    # Build the constant cross-section side profile in the YZ plane
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        # Vertical plate: front face at Y = 0, back face at Y = T
        Rectangle(T, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

        with BuildLine() as ln:

                (L, 0),
                (L - offset_x, -offset_y),
                (T - offset_x, V - offset_y),
                (T, V)
            )
        make_face()
    # Extrude the profile across the width W, centred at X = 0
    extrude(amount=W/2, both=True)

body_len   = 77.8         # length of the ø6.5 body

tip_len    = 80.0 - body_len   # 2.2 (overall 80)

edge_r     = 0.1          # R0.1 corner rounding

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # main ø6.5 body
    Cylinder(body_dia / 2, body_len,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # reduced ø2.2 spigot at the top end
    with Locations((0, 0, body_len)):
        Cylinder(tip_dia / 2, tip_len,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ø2.2 axial bore through the ø6.5 body
    Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, body_len,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # R0.1 rounding only on the two outer circular end edges
    # (outer faces -> circle edges at z=body_len (r=3.25) and z=80 (r=1.1))

            (abs(e.radius - tip_dia / 2) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Z - 80.0) < 1e-6)

cbore_depth = 14.1    # counterbore depth

                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

                                       align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

BEND    = (52.0, 42.0)

def bar(p1, p2, w=arm_w):
    (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = p1, p2
    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    ln = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    ux, uy = dx / ln, dy / ln
    nx, ny = -uy, ux
    h = w / 2.0
    pts = [
        (x1 + nx * h, y1 + ny * h),
        (x2 + nx * h, y2 + ny * h),
        (x2 - nx * h, y2 - ny * h),
        (x1 - nx * h, y1 - ny * h),
    ]
    return Polygon(*pts, align=None)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----
THICK = 6.1          # plate thickness
ARM_W = 4.8          # arm width  (= 2 * R2.4)
EPS   = 0.01         # auxiliary skeleton width (tiny)

# ---- key points of the front view ----
A = (0.0,   0.0)     # lower-left tip
B = (80.0,  0.0)     # lower-right tip  (overall width = 80)
C = (14.0, 73.6)     # upper tip        (overall height = 73.6)
J = (40.0, 36.0)     # junction of the three arms


def make_slot(p, q, w):
    """A slot (stadium) of width w running from p to q."""
    dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
    length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    angle  = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))
    s = SlotOverall(length, w)
    s = Rotation(0, 0, angle) * s
    s = Pos((p[0] + q[0]) / 2.0, (p[1] + q[1]) / 2.0) * s
    return s


def inset(tip, hub, d):
    """Point at distance d from `tip` toward `hub`."""
    dx, dy = hub[0] - tip[0], hub[1] - tip[1]
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    return (tip[0] + dx / L * d, tip[1] + dy / L * d)


# Build a very thin skeleton (three slots meeting at J), then offset it
# outward.  The tip is inset by ARM_W/2 so that the offset tip cap lands
# exactly on the nominal tip point and gives a rounded end of radius ARM_W/2.
ins = ARM_W / 2.0
skel = (make_slot(inset(A, J, ins), J, EPS)
        + make_slot(inset(B, J, ins), J, EPS)
        + make_slot(inset(C, J, ins), J, EPS))

grown = offset(skel, amount=(ARM_W - EPS) / 2.0)

part = extrude(grown, amount=THICK)

export_step(part, "output.step")

        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # hex on top
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(H_body)):
        RegularPolygon(hex_R, 6)
    extrude(amount=H_total - H_body)

from math import sqrt

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
od            = 80.0    # outer diameter  ø80
width         = 36.4    # overall height  36.4
bore_face_dia = 43.6    # spherical bore opening diameter at the top/bottom faces

sphere_r = sqrt(bore_face_r**2 + half_w**2)   # ~28.4

    # ---- Revolved outer body: cylinder ø80 x 36.4 ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0, half_w),
                (od / 2, half_w),
                (od / 2, -half_w),

                close=True,

    # stepped-down top at the right hand end
    with Locations((step_x, 0, right_height)):
        Box(length - step_x, depth, height - right_height,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # rectangular recess in the front face (leaves the two end feet)
    with Locations((recess_x0, 0, recess_floor)):
        Box(recess_x1 - recess_x0, recess_depth, height - recess_floor + 1.0,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # two half-cylinder grooves along the full depth at the bottom
    with Locations((groove_cx[0], 0, 0), (groove_cx[1], 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(groove_r, depth, rotation=(-90, 0, 0),
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 8 x R1.5 : four outer vertical corners + four recess vertical edges
    corners = [(0.0, 0.0), (0.0, depth),
               (length, 0.0), (length, depth),

               (recess_x1, 0.0), (recess_x1, recess_depth)]

    vert_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

        for px, py in corners:
            if abs(c.X - px) < 1e-6 and abs(c.Y - py) < 1e-6:
                sel.append(e)
                break
    fillet(sel, radius=fillet_r)

    Box(length, depth, height, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
W = 58.7          # overall width  (X)
L = 80.0          # overall depth  (Y)
H = 24.5          # overall height (Z)
T = 2.0           # wall thickness

R_BACK  = 7.7     # 2x back corner radius
R_FRONT = 1.3     # 2x front corner radius

# front circular cut-out (large arc in plan view)
ARC_INSET  = 2.5                      # arc ends inset from the side edges
SAG        = 33.0                     # arc sagitta measured from the front edge
half_chord = W / 2 - ARC_INSET
CY    = (SAG**2 - half_chord**2) / (2 * SAG)   # arc centre offset from front edge
R_ARC = SAG - CY                                # arc radius

# through-slots in the walls
SLOT_D      = 2.0
BACK_SLOTS  = [(18.0, 4.0), (36.7, 4.0)]   # (x start, width) on back edge
LEFT_SLOT   = (32.3, 10.3)                 # (y start, length) on left edge
RIGHT_SLOT  = (64.5, 10.0)                 # (y start, length) on right edge

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- outer profile (plan view) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        Rectangle(W, L, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
        fillet(sk.vertices().group_by(Axis.Y)[-1], radius=R_BACK)   # back corners
        fillet(sk.vertices().group_by(Axis.Y)[0],  radius=R_FRONT)  # front corners

        # big front arc cut-out
        with Locations((W / 2, CY)):
            Circle(R_ARC, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # back edge slots
        for x, w in BACK_SLOTS:
            with Locations((x, L)):
                Rectangle(w, SLOT_D, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MAX), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # left edge slot
        with Locations((0, LEFT_SLOT[0])):
            Rectangle(SLOT_D, LEFT_SLOT[1], align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # right edge slot
        with Locations((W, RIGHT_SLOT[0])):
            Rectangle(SLOT_D, RIGHT_SLOT[1], align=(Align.MAX, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

NOTCH_D = 5.0           # notch depth from top edge

body = fillet(body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).group_by(Axis.Y)[0],  R_FRONT)

from build123d import *

# Dimensions from drawing (interpreted as a block with a concave cylindrical cut)
width = 66.5      # X dimension (width, across the part)
depth = 51.4      # Y dimension (depth, into the side view)
height = 80.0     # Z dimension (height, vertical)
radius = 33.3     # radius of concave cut at the bottom-rear edge

# Create the main rectangular block (min corner at origin)
block = Box(width, depth, height)
block = Pos(width / 2, depth / 2, height / 2) * block

# The concave cut is along the bottom-rear edge (Y = depth, Z = 0).
# The arc is tangent to both the bottom face (Z = 0) and the rear face (Y = depth).
# Arc center: (Y = depth - radius, Z = radius)
center_y = depth - radius   # 51.4 - 33.3 = 18.1
center_z = radius            # 33.3

# Build the 2D profile of the material to remove in the YZ plane (X = 0):
# a rectangle from (center_y, 0) to (depth, center_z) minus the quarter-disk
# of the circle centered at (center_y, center_z) that lies inside the rectangle.
rect = Rectangle(radius, radius, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
rect = Pos(center_y, 0) * rect

circle = Circle(radius)
circle = Pos(center_y, center_z) * circle

profile = rect - circle

# Extrude this profile along the X direction (normal of Plane.YZ) through the entire width
cut_solid = extrude(Plane.YZ * profile, amount=width)

# Subtract the cut from the block to create the concave surface
part = block - cut_solid

# Export the final solid
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# --- Dimensions from the drawing ---
THICKNESS   = 10.0      # plate thickness
BASE_WIDTH  = 61.8      # overall width at base
HOLE_DIA    = 30.0      # through hole diameter
BOSS_R      = 20.0      # R20 top radius
CENTER_H    = 80.0      # height of boss center above base

# --- Geometry of the tangent sides ---
cx, cy = 0.0, CENTER_H
px, py = BASE_WIDTH / 2.0, 0.0        # right base corner

dc         = math.hypot(px - cx, py - cy)
alpha      = math.atan2(cy - py, cx - px)     # angle from corner to circle center
half_ang   = math.asin(BOSS_R / dc)            # half of tangent cone
tang_dir   = alpha - half_ang                  # direction of the upper tangent
tlen       = math.sqrt(dc * dc - BOSS_R * BOSS_R)
tx         = px + tlen * math.cos(tang_dir)    # tangent point (right)
ty         = py + tlen * math.sin(tang_dir)

# --- Build the part ---
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Line((px, py), (tx, ty))                           # right tapered side
            ThreePointArc((tx, ty), (cx, cy + BOSS_R), (-tx, ty))  # top arc
            Line((-tx, ty), (-px, py))                         # left tapered side
            Line((-px, py), (px, py))                          # base
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=THICKNESS)

    # Ø30 through hole
    with Locations((cx, cy, THICKNESS / 2)):
        Cylinder(radius=HOLE_DIA / 2, height=THICKNESS * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions (from drawing) ----------------
hex_af    = 16.7      # head width across flats  (16.7 A/F)
head_od   = 21.7      # head width across rounded corners
head_h    = 13.3      # head height
shank_d   = 16.7      # shank diameter
shank_len = 66.7      # shank length (head underside -> very bottom)
tip_d     = 13.3      # reduced end diameter
tip_len   = 5.0       # reduced end length
fillet_r  = 1.7       # 2x R1.7
cham_w    = 5.8       # top chamfer length along surface
cham_ang  = 30.0      # top chamfer angle

# derived
circ_r = hex_af / math.sqrt(3.0)         # hex circumradius (across corners /2)
lobe_r = head_od / 2.0 - circ_r          # corner rounding lobe radius
cham_h = cham_w * math.cos(math.radians(cham_ang))   # vertical extent of chamfer

def hex_pts():
    return [(circ_r * math.cos(math.radians(60 * i)),
             circ_r * math.sin(math.radians(60 * i))) for i in range(6)]

def add_head_profile():
    with BuildLine():
        Polyline(*hex_pts(), close=True)
    make_face()
    for p in hex_pts():
        with Locations(p):
            Circle(lobe_r)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # --- reduced end (bottom)  Ø13.3 ---
    Cylinder(radius=tip_d / 2, height=tip_len,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # --- shank Ø16.7 ---
    with Locations((0, 0, tip_len)):
        Cylinder(radius=shank_d / 2, height=shank_len - tip_len,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # --- hex head, straight portion ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(shank_len)):
        add_head_profile()
    extrude(amount=head_h - cham_h)

    # --- hex head, chamfered crown (tapered extrude => 5.8 x 30deg chamfer) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(shank_len + head_h - cham_h)):
        add_head_profile()
    extrude(amount=cham_h, taper=cham_ang)

    # --- shoulder fillet R1.7 (shank -> reduced end) ---
    shoulder = (bp.edges()
                .filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
                .filter_by_position(Axis.Z, tip_len - 0.01, tip_len + 0.01))
    fillet(shoulder, radius=fillet_r)

    # --- bottom round R1.7 ---
    bottom = bp.edges().filter_by_position(Axis.Z, -0.05, 0.05)
    fillet(bottom, radius=fillet_r)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

hook_cl   = ht                   # 3.8  -> hook left face at x = 0

                     (wall_cl, foot_cl),
                     (wall_cl, top_cl),
                     (hook_cl, top_cl),
                     (hook_cl, lip_cl),
                     (lip_end, lip_cl))

from build123d import *

# ---------------- dimensions from the drawing ----------------
L        = 80.0    # overall length (X)
H        = 70.6    # overall height (Z)
T        = 7.6     # plate thickness of top arm / vertical leg
W        = 12.0    # part depth (Y)
FOOT_T   = 12.6    # bottom foot slab thickness
FOOT_L   = 42.0    # X position of the free (left) end of the foot
BOSS_D   = 12.0    # boss diameter
BOSS_H   = 8.2     # boss height above foot top (top of boss at 20.8)
HOOK_BOT = 40.9    # bottom of the hook tab on the top arm
R7       = 7.6     # 3x R7.6 corner radii
R5       = 5.7     # foot / inner corner radius
R3       = 3.8     # hook radius
BOSS_X   = L - T - BOSS_D / 2.0   # boss tangent to inner face of leg

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ------------- main "C" shaped profile (XZ plane) -------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((FOOT_L, 0), (L, 0), (L, H), (0, H), (0, HOOK_BOT),
                     (T, HOOK_BOT), (T, H - T), (L - T, H - T),
                     (L - T, FOOT_T), (FOOT_L, FOOT_T),
                     close=True)
        make_face()

        def pick(x, y):
            return min(sk.vertices(), key=lambda v: (v.X - x) ** 2 + (v.Y - y) ** 2)

        fillet(pick(L, H), R7)              # outer top-right corner of arm/leg
        fillet(pick(L - T, H - T), R7)      # inner corner arm underside / leg
        fillet(pick(L, 0), R5)              # outer bottom-right corner
        fillet(pick(L - T, FOOT_T), R5)     # inner corner leg / foot top
        fillet(pick(T, H - T), R3)          # hook tab into arm underside
        fillet(pick(T, HOOK_BOT), R3)       # hook tab bottom (inner)
        fillet(pick(0, HOOK_BOT), R3)       # hook tab bottom (outer)
        fillet(pick(FOOT_L, 0), R5)         # foot free end, bottom
        fillet(pick(FOOT_L, FOOT_T), R5)    # foot free end, top

    extrude(amount=W)

    # ------------- boss on top of the foot -------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(FOOT_T)):
        with Locations((BOSS_X, -W / 2)):
            Circle(BOSS_D / 2)
    extrude(amount=BOSS_H)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

groove_w = 1.1       # groove width
groove_len = 70.3    # groove length
groove_depth = 0.6   # groove depth

# ---- Base frame ----
part = Box(length, thickness, height,
           align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---- Cut central window opening (through in depth direction) ----
opening = Pos(0, 0, opening_z0) * Box(opening_len, thickness + 2, opening_h,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= opening

# ---- Cut top groove into ceiling of opening ----
top_groove = Pos(0, 0, opening_z0 + opening_h) * Box(
    groove_len, groove_w, groove_depth,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= top_groove

# ---- Cut bottom groove into floor of opening ----
bottom_groove = Pos(0, 0, opening_z0 - groove_depth) * Box(
    groove_len, groove_w, groove_depth,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part -= bottom_groove

flange_h    = 7.0           # hub height above plate
flange_top  = plate_thk + flange_h   # 11.6

recess_dia  = 27.7          # counterbore diameter
recess_dep  = 5.8           # counterbore depth
recess_flr  = flange_top - recess_dep  # 5.8

boss_af     = 23.2          # hex boss across flats
boss_top    = 23.2          # overall part height
boss_cr     = (boss_af / 2) / cos(radians(30))   # 13.39 circumradius

hole_dia    = 9.3           # central thru hole
mount_dia   = 8.1           # mounting holes
mount_off   = 28.4          # hole offset from centre (11.6 from ends)

        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # circular hub

        Cylinder(flange_dia / 2, flange_h,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(recess_flr)):
